column2: Mới: newspaper, magazine, post, postcard | Ôn (từ nối Unit 4): maths (US math), information, diary, university, send
column3: Mới: read the newspaper / a comic magazine / post a postcard / send it by post | Ôn: no problem / a lot of information
column4: [Ngữ pháp: hiện tại đơn và hiện tại tiếp diễn] Grandpa reads the newspaper every morning. / Right now he is reading a magazine. / I'm writing a postcard to my cousin. / Can you post it for me? – No problem! / [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Con nghe truyện tiếng Trung '爷爷的杂志', nói lại ý chính cho Leo bằng 2 câu tiếng Anh (ghi âm): Grandpa is reading a magazine about animals. Nhan's cousin is sending a postcard.
column5: Grandpa's Magazine — Every morning, Grandpa reads the newspaper. Today he is reading a magazine. On page ten, there is a lot of information about animals. Then the phone rings. It's Nhan's cousin from university! 'I'm sending you a postcard by post,' she says. Grandpa and Nhan are very happy.

column7: Mới: 报纸 bàozhǐ (= newspaper), 杂志 zázhì (= magazine), 响 xiǎng (= ring: the phone rings) | Nghe làm quen: 寄 jì (= post), 明信片 míngxìnpiàn (= postcard) | Ôn (từ nối Unit 4): 页 yè, 知识 zhīshi, 大学 dàxué, 爷爷 yéye
column8: Mới: 看报纸 kàn bàozhǐ / 一本杂志 yì běn zázhì / 第十页 dì shí yè / 电话响了 diànhuà xiǎng le / 很多知识 hěn duō zhīshi | Nghe làm quen: 寄明信片 jì míngxìnpiàn
column9: [Cầu nối] Grandpa reads the newspaper every morning. ↔ 爷爷每天早上看报纸。(Yéye měi tiān zǎoshang kàn bàozhǐ.) · giống: thói quen, every morning ↔ 每天早上 · khác: read the newspaper ↔ 看报纸 (dùng 看); the phone rings ↔ 电话响了 / [Ngữ pháp: 每天 (thói quen) và 正在 (đang làm)] 爷爷每天早上看报纸。(Yéye měi tiān zǎoshang kàn bàozhǐ.) / 现在他正在看杂志。(Xiànzài tā zhèngzài kàn zázhì.) / 这本杂志里有很多知识。(Zhè běn zázhì lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhīshi.) / 电话响了！(Diànhuà xiǎng le!) / 我正在给表姐写明信片。(Wǒ zhèngzài gěi biǎojiě xiě míngxìnpiàn.) / 你能帮我寄吗？——没问题！(Nǐ néng bāng wǒ jì ma? — Méi wèntí!)
column10: 爷爷的杂志 — 爷爷每天早上看报纸。今天他正在看一本杂志。杂志第十页有很多动物的知识。这时候，电话响了。是Nhan在大学读书的表姐！表姐说：“我给你们寄了一张明信片！”爷爷和Nhan都很高兴。(Yéye měi tiān zǎoshang kàn bàozhǐ. Jīntiān tā zhèngzài kàn yì běn zázhì. Zázhì dì shí yè yǒu hěn duō dòngwù de zhīshi. Zhè shíhou, diànhuà xiǎng le. Shì Nhan zài dàxué dúshū de biǎojiě! Biǎojiě shuō: “Wǒ gěi nǐmen jìle yì zhāng míngxìnpiàn!” Yéye hé Nhan dōu hěn gāoxìng.)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: hiện tại tiếp diễn – đang làm gì] What are you doing? – I'm looking for the torch. / Please turn on the torch. / The wifi isn't working now. / What's your telephone number?
column5: No TV Tonight — It's a stormy night. The lights go off and the TV turns off too. Leo finds the torch and turns it on. 'The wifi isn't working,' says Mum. 'How can we talk to Grandma?' asks Leo. 'I know her telephone number. Let's call her!' says Dad.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "What's your telephone number kids English"
column7: Mới: 电子邮件 diànzǐ yóujiàn (= email), 号码 hàomǎ (= number), 联系 liánxì (= talk to, call) | Nghe làm quen: 手电筒 shǒudiàntǒng (= torch) | Ôn: 打电话 dǎ diànhuà, 上网 shàngwǎng, 电灯 diàndēng, 电话 diànhuà
column8: Mới: 电话号码 diànhuà hàomǎ / 发电子邮件 fā diànzǐ yóujiàn / 跟奶奶联系 gēn nǎinai liánxì | Nghe làm quen: 打开手电筒 dǎkāi shǒudiàntǒng | Ôn: 上不了网 shàng bu liǎo wǎng
column9: [Cầu nối] What's your telephone number? ↔ 你的电话号码是多少？(Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?) · giống: telephone number ↔ 电话号码 cùng thứ tự; số đọc từng chữ số ở cả hai tiếng · khác: What đứng đầu câu ↔ 多少 đứng cuối câu; email ↔ 电子邮件 / [Ngữ pháp: 正在 + động từ] 妈妈正在发电子邮件。(Māma zhèngzài fā diànzǐ yóujiàn.) / 你的电话号码是多少？(Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?) / 我们怎么跟你联系？(Wǒmen zěnme gēn nǐ liánxì?) / 你正在做什么？——我正在找手电筒。(Nǐ zhèngzài zuò shénme? — Wǒ zhèngzài zhǎo shǒudiàntǒng.) / 请打开手电筒。(Qǐng dǎkāi shǒudiàntǒng.) / 现在上不了网。(Xiànzài shàng bu liǎo wǎng.)
column10: 没有电视的晚上 — 晚上下大雨。突然停电了，灯灭了，电视也关了。Leo找到手电筒，打开了。妈妈说：“上不了网了。”Leo问：“我们怎么跟奶奶联系？”爸爸说：“我知道奶奶的电话号码，我们打电话吧！”(Wǎnshang xià dà yǔ. Tūrán tíngdiàn le, dēng miè le, diànshì yě guān le. Leo zhǎodào shǒudiàntǒng, dǎkāi le. Māma shuō: “Shàng bu liǎo wǎng le.” Leo wèn: “Wǒmen zěnme gēn nǎinai liánxì?” Bàba shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào nǎinai de diànhuà hàomǎ, wǒmen dǎ diànhuà ba!”)

Are you ready? 准备好了吗？" · Chuyển ý: "Now, let's play a game. 现在我们玩游戏。" · Khen: "Great job! 真棒！" · Nhắc: "One at a time, please. 一个一个说。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): wifi, torch / flashlight / 联系 1) Nghe và tô màu / viết (dạng Flyers Listening Part 5, 5 lệnh): Colour the torch yellow. / Write 'WIFI' on the box. / Colour the telephone red. / Draw a cartoon on the TV. / Colour the newspaper grey. 2) Phân biệt Anh – Anh và Anh – Mỹ (nối 4 cặp): torch – flashlight / programme – program / film – movie / football – soccer. 3) Ôn không tranh – nghe định nghĩa, nói từ (5 câu): You use it to see in the dark. (torch) / You read it every morning to find out the news. (newspaper) / You need it to go on the internet. (wifi) / It's a funny film. (comedy) / It's a TV programme with lots of questions. (quiz)
column15: The Dark Evening — It's a stormy evening. Leo is watching a wonderful action film. Then the lights go off and the TV turns off. Leo is worried. 'Where's the torch?' Dad finds a flashlight in the kitchen and turns it on. 'The wifi isn't working,' says Mum. 'We can't watch our programme online.' So Anna starts a quiz: 'What's red, round and in your fridge?' 'A tomato!' says Leo. The family plays quiz games by torchlight. 'This is more interesting than TV!' says Leo.
column16: Turn On the Torch (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat) — Turn, turn, turn it on, turn the torch on, please! / No TV and no wifi, the lights are off tonight. / Turn, turn, turn it off, turn the torch off, please! / The lights are on, the TV's on, everything's all right!
column17: Mới: 号码 hàomǎ, 联系 liánxì | Ôn: 电话 diànhuà, 新闻 xīnwén, 卡通片 kǎtōngpiàn, 搞笑片 gǎoxiàopiàn, 竞猜 jìngcāi, 有趣 yǒuqù, 惊奇 jīngqí, 担心 dānxīn, 报纸 bàozhǐ, 杂志 zázhì, 太阳镜 tàiyángjìng, 网购 wǎnggòu | Nghe làm quen: 手电筒 shǒudiàntǒng, 频道 píndào
column18: 1) Nghe và tô màu / vẽ (như bài 1 tiếng Anh, 5 lệnh): 把手电筒涂成黄色。/ 在盒子上画一个无线网标志。/ 把电话涂成红色。/ 在电视上画一个卡通人物。/ 把报纸涂成灰色。(Bǎ shǒudiàntǒng túchéng huángsè. / Zài hézi shang huà yí gè wúxiànwǎng biāozhì. / Bǎ diànhuà túchéng hóngsè. / Zài diànshì shang huà yí gè kǎtōng rénwù. / Bǎ bàozhǐ túchéng huīsè.) 2) Ghép câu hỏi với câu trả lời (4 cặp): 你正在做什么？– 我正在发电子邮件。/ 你的电话号码是多少？– 是 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2。/ 我们怎么跟你联系？– 给我打电话吧。/ 你喜欢什么电影？– 我喜欢动作片。 3) Ôn không tranh – nghe câu, nói từ (5 câu, như bài 3 tiếng Anh): 晚上很黑，我们用它看路。(手电筒 – con chỉ tranh) / 每天早上爷爷看它，知道新闻。(报纸) / 没有它，就上不了网。(无线网 wúxiànwǎng – con chỉ tranh) / 很好笑的电影。(搞笑片) / 电视上有很多问题，大家来猜。(竞猜) 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng thẻ số điện thoại: rối Leo đọc My telephone number is 6285 3910., rối Xiaomei đọc 我的电话号码是62853910。(Wǒ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì liù èr bā wǔ sān jiǔ yāo líng.); con nhận ra số đọc từng chữ số ở cả hai tiếng (1 đọc là yāo), khác: What's …? đầu câu ↔ 是多少？cuối câu; email ↔ 电子邮件. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Con đọc bảng thông tin tiếng Anh 'TV tonight' (Channel 1 – the news – 7 p.m. / Channel 5 – a cartoon – 7.30 p.m. / Channel 7 – a quiz – 8 p.m.), nói lại ý chính cho bạn chỉ hiểu tiếng Trung: 七点有新闻，七点半有卡通片，八点有竞猜。(Qī diǎn yǒu xīnwén, qī diǎn bàn yǒu kǎtōngpiàn, bā diǎn yǒu jìngcāi.)
column19: 下大雨的晚上 — 晚上下大雨，Leo正在看一部很精彩的动作片。突然停电了，灯灭了，电视也关了。Leo有一点儿担心：“手电筒在哪儿？”爸爸在厨房找到手电筒，打开了。妈妈说：“上不了网，我们不能在网上看了。”所以Anna开始竞猜：“什么东西是红色的、圆圆的，在冰箱里？”Leo说：“西红柿！”一家人在手电筒的光下玩竞猜游戏。Leo说：“这比看电视更有趣！”(Wǎnshang xià dà yǔ, Leo zhèngzài kàn yí bù hěn jīngcǎi de dòngzuòpiàn. Tūrán tíngdiàn le, dēng miè le, diànshì yě guān le. Leo yǒu yìdiǎnr dānxīn: “Shǒudiàntǒng zài nǎr?” Bàba zài chúfáng zhǎodào shǒudiàntǒng, dǎkāi le. Māma shuō: “Shàng bu liǎo wǎng, wǒmen bù néng zài wǎng shang kàn le.” Suǒyǐ Anna kāishǐ jìngcāi: “Shénme dōngxi shì hóngsè de, yuányuán de, zài bīngxiāng lǐ?” Leo shuō: “Xīhóngshì!” Yì jiā rén zài shǒudiàntǒng de guāng xià wán jìngcāi yóuxì. Leo shuō: “Zhè bǐ kàn diànshì gèng yǒuqù!”)
column20: 打开手电筒 (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat, như bài tiếng Anh) — 打开，打开，打开手电筒，请你打开它！没有电视没有网，今天停电了。关掉，关掉，关掉手电筒，请你关掉它！灯亮了，电视开了，一切都很好！(Dǎkāi, dǎkāi, dǎkāi shǒudiàntǒng, qǐng nǐ dǎkāi tā! Méiyǒu diànshì méiyǒu wǎng, jīntiān tíngdiàn le. Guāndiào, guāndiào, guāndiào shǒudiàntǒng, qǐng nǐ guāndiào tā! Dēng liàng le, diànshì kāi le, yíqiè dōu hěn hǎo!)

Anna dàizhe xīn shǒubiǎo, hěn gāoxìng.)
column10: 电视上的手表 — Anna的妈妈正在看电视，电视上在卖东西。妈妈说：“看！这块手表在网上很便宜。”Anna很惊奇：“真的吗？真便宜！”妈妈就网购了。两天以后，Anna戴着新手表和太阳镜。爸爸说：“真棒！”(Anna de māma zhèngzài kàn diànshì, diànshì shang zài mài dōngxi. Māma shuō: “Kàn! Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo zài wǎng shang hěn piányi.” Anna hěn jīngqí: “Zhēn de ma? Zhēn piányi!” Māma jiù wǎnggòu le. Liǎng tiān yǐhòu, Anna dàizhe xīn shǒubiǎo hé tàiyángjìng. Bàba shuō: “Zhēn bàng!”)

column10: 电视上的Leo — 今天Leo参加电视竞猜！他穿着新衣服和新运动鞋。他有一点儿担心。在家里，奶奶穿着睡衣，正在看电视。最后一个问题是：“每天早上，我们看什么知道新闻？”Leo说：“报纸！”他赢了！大家都很惊奇。第二天，报纸上有Leo的照片。(Jīntiān Leo cānjiā diànshì jìngcāi! column15: Leo on TV — Today Leo is on a quiz programme! He is wearing new clothes and his new trainers. He is a little worried. At home, Grandma is watching in her pyjamas and Dad is recording it on his phone. The first question is about a cartoon. Leo knows it! The second question is about the news. Leo knows it too! The last question is: 'What do we read every morning to find out the news?' Leo says, 'A newspaper!' He wins! What a surprise! The next day, Leo's photo is in the newspaper and in a magazine. 'You're famous now!' says Anna. Leo laughs. 'No, I'm just Leo!'

column18: 1) Đọc và phán đoán đúng/sai theo truyện (dạng YCT4 đọc – phán đoán, 4 câu): Leo参加电视竞猜。(✓) / 奶奶正在看报纸。(✗) / 最后的回答是“报纸”。(✓) / 报纸上有爸爸的照片。(✗) 2) Phiên dịch nhí theo cặp – Anh → Trung (4 câu): I'm watching TV. / Dad watches the news every evening. / Please turn off the TV. / This comedy is very funny. 3) Dự án nhỏ 'Bản tin của lớp': 晚上好！这是___新闻。/ ___正在看卡通片。/ ___每天看报纸。 4) YCT口试（中级）第二部分 看图说话 (mẫu; cô là giám khảo, từng em; con nhìn tranh, chuẩn bị 1 phút rồi nói một đoạn 4–5 câu): tranh 'cả nhà xem tivi buổi tối' – câu mẫu: 现在是晚上八点。爸爸正在看新闻，奶奶正在看报纸。Leo和妹妹想看卡通片。妈妈说：“看完新闻再看卡通片吧。”大家都很高兴。(Xiànzài shì wǎnshang bā diǎn. Bàba zhèngzài kàn xīnwén, nǎinai zhèngzài kàn bàozhǐ. Leo hé mèimei xiǎng kàn kǎtōngpiàn. Māma shuō: “Kàn wán xīnwén zài kàn kǎtōngpiàn ba.” Dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.) 5) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh 'cả nhà xem tivi buổi tối' của bài nói: một bạn nói câu tiếng Anh, bạn kia nói câu tiếng Trung cùng nghĩa: Grandma is watching TV. ↔ 奶奶正在看电视。/ Leo is famous now. ↔ Leo现在很有名。(Nǎinai zhèngzài kàn diànshì. / Leo xiànzài hěn yǒumíng.); cả lớp chỉ ra: famous ↔ 有名 đứng sau 很, không cần is.
column19: 有名的Leo — 今天Leo参加电视竞猜！他穿着新衣服和新运动鞋。他有一点儿担心。在家里，奶奶穿着睡衣正在看电视，爸爸正在用手机录像。第一个问题是关于卡通片的，Leo知道！第二个问题是关于新闻的，Leo也知道！最后一个问题是：“每天早上，我们看什么知道新闻？”Leo说：“报纸！”他赢了！大家都很惊奇。第二天，报纸和杂志上都有Leo的照片。Anna说：“你现在很有名！”Leo笑着说：“我还是Leo！”(Jīntiān Leo cānjiā diànshì jìngcāi! Tā chuānzhe xīn yīfu hé xīn yùndòngxié. Tā yǒu yìdiǎnr dānxīn. Zài jiā lǐ, nǎinai chuānzhe shuìyī zhèngzài kàn diànshì, bàba zhèngzài yòng shǒujī lùxiàng. Dì-yī gè wèntí shì guānyú kǎtōngpiàn de, Leo zhīdào! Dì-èr gè wèntí shì guānyú xīnwén de, Leo yě zhīdào! Zuìhòu yí gè wèntí shì: “Měi tiān zǎoshang, wǒmen kàn shénme zhīdào xīnwén?” Leo shuō: “Bàozhǐ!” Tā yíng le! Dàjiā dōu hěn jīngqí. Dì-èr tiān, bàozhǐ hé zázhì shang dōu yǒu Leo de zhàopiàn. Anna shuō: “Nǐ xiànzài hěn yǒumíng!” Leo xiàozhe shuō: “Wǒ háishi Leo!”)
column20: 我们的电视歌 (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus, như bài tiếng Anh) — 电视新闻一直播，一直播，一直播。电视新闻一直播，每天晚上！卡通片又好笑又奇怪……每个星期天！电视竞猜真有趣……每个星期五！关掉电视去睡觉，去睡觉，去睡觉。关掉电视去睡觉，大家晚安！(Diànshì xīnwén yìzhí bō, yìzhí bō, yìzhí bō. Diànshì xīnwén yìzhí bō, měi tiān wǎnshang! Kǎtōngpiàn yòu hǎoxiào yòu qíguài… měi gè xīngqītiān! Diànshì jìngcāi zhēn yǒuqù… měi gè xīngqīwǔ! Guāndiào diànshì qù shuìjiào, qù shuìjiào, qù shuìjiào. Guāndiào diànshì qù shuìjiào, dàjiā wǎn'ān!)

column10: 小小新闻员 — Anna在家里做自己的新闻节目。“晚上好！这里是Anna频道。下面是新闻。Leo正在看一本很奇怪的杂志。妈妈正在网上买太阳镜。爸爸正在沙发上睡觉！”大家都笑了。奶奶说：“这个节目太精彩了！”(Anna zài jiā lǐ zuò zìjǐ de xīnwén jiémù. “Wǎnshang hǎo! Zhèlǐ shì Anna píndào. Xiàmiàn shì xīnwén. Leo zhèngzài kàn yì běn hěn qíguài de zázhì. Māma zhèngzài wǎng shang mǎi tàiyángjìng. Bàba zhèngzài shāfā shang shuìjiào!” Dàjiā dōu xiào le. Nǎinai shuō: “Zhège jiémù tài jīngcǎi le!”)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: động từ + trạng từ chỉ cách thức (well, beautifully)] I can play the piano well. / She plays the violin beautifully. / What instrument can you play? – I can play the drums. / Listen to this tune! It's wonderful.
column5: Anna's Violin — Anna has got a new instrument. It's a violin! Her dad plays a very big bass. Every day at five p.m., she practises for a short time. At first, her tune is strange and Leo laughs. But Anna practises every day. In September, she plays the violin beautifully. 'What a wonderful tune!' says Leo.

column9: [Cầu nối] She plays the violin beautifully. ↔ 她小提琴拉得很好听。(Tā xiǎotíqín lā de hěn hǎotīng.) · giống: cùng khen chơi đàn hay · khác: beautifully (-ly) cuối câu ↔ 拉得很好听 (động từ + 得 + 很 + tính từ); play the piano / violin / drums ↔ 弹钢琴 / 拉小提琴 / 打鼓 (mỗi nhạc cụ một động từ) / [Ngữ pháp: bổ ngữ trạng thái – động từ + 得 + 很 + tính từ] 我钢琴弹得很好。(Wǒ gāngqín tán de hěn hǎo.) / 她小提琴拉得很好听。(Tā xiǎotíqín lā de hěn hǎotīng.) / 你会弹钢琴吗？——会，我最近每天都弹。(Nǐ huì tán gāngqín ma? — Huì, wǒ zuìjìn měi tiān dōu tán.) / 哥哥鼓打得很好。(Gēge gǔ dǎ de hěn hǎo.)
column10: Anna的小提琴 — Anna有一把新小提琴。爸爸拉一把很大的低音提琴。她每天下午五点拉一会儿。开始，她拉得不好听，Leo笑了。可是Anna每天都练习。九月，她拉得很好听！Leo说：“真好听！”(Anna yǒu yì bǎ xīn xiǎotíqín. Bàba lā yì bǎ hěn dà de dīyīn tíqín. Tā měi tiān xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn lā yíhuìr. Kāishǐ, tā lā de bù hǎotīng, Leo xiào le. Kěshì Anna měi tiān dōu liànxí. Jiǔyuè, tā lā de hěn hǎotīng! Leo shuō: “Zhēn hǎotīng!”)

column14: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon, musicians! 小音乐家们好！" · Chuyển ý: "Let's listen. 我们听一听。" · Khen: "You play very well! 你弹得很好！" · Nhắc: "Quiet, please. 请安静。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): tune, solo / 低音 1) Nghe âm thanh và chọn nhạc cụ (5 câu): drum / violin / piano / guitar / bass (nghe hiểu). 2) Sắp xếp từ thành câu có trạng từ (4 câu): plays / beautifully / she / the violin → She plays the violin beautifully. / can / I / well / the piano / play → I can play the piano well. / sings / very / he / well → He sings very well. / starts / at seven p.m. / the performance → The performance starts at seven p.m. 3) Đọc thiệp mời và trả lời (dạng Flyers Reading Part 4, 4 câu): What is the invitation for? (a school concert) / What day is it? (Saturday) / What time does it start? (seven p.m.) / Who is playing a drum solo? (Xiaomei's brother). Phương án nhiễu trong tranh: fridge / oven / cushion.
column15: The School Concert — Xiaomei gets an invitation in an envelope: 'Come to our school concert on Saturday at seven p.m.!' There are lots of instruments at the concert: a piano, violins, drums and a very big bass. First, the children play together in an ensemble. Then Xiaomei's brother plays a drum solo. He plays very well! Last, Anna plays a happy tune on her violin. She plays beautifully. 'What a wonderful performance!' says Mum.
column16: Play Your Instrument (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — Leo plays the drums so well, drums so well, drums so well. / Leo plays the drums so well, boom, boom, boom! / Anna plays the violin, violin, violin. / Anna plays the violin beautifully! / Come and play a happy tune, happy tune, happy tune. / Come and play a happy tune at our school concert!
column17: Mới: 钢琴 gāngqín, 弹钢琴 tán gāngqín, 小提琴 xiǎotíqín, 鼓 gǔ, 低音 dīyīn, 演出 yǎnchū, 票 piào, 一共 yígòng, 万 wàn | Ôn: 吉他 jítā, 乐队 yuèduì, 九月 jiǔyuè, 手套 shǒutào, 下午 xiàwǔ | Nghe làm quen: 邀请卡 yāoqǐngkǎ
column18: 1) Nghe và chọn tranh (dạng YCT4 nghe – chọn tranh, 5 câu): 弹钢琴 / 拉小提琴 / 打鼓 / 低音提琴 / 唱歌. 2) Điền 得 và hoàn thành câu (4 câu): 我钢琴弹___很好。/ 她小提琴拉___很好听。/ 哥哥鼓打___非常好。/ 他唱歌唱___怎么样？ 3) Đọc thiệp mời và trả lời (như bài 3 tiếng Anh, 4 câu): 这是什么演出的邀请卡？——学校的演出。/ 星期几？——星期六。/ 几点开始？——晚上七点。/ 谁一个人打鼓？——Xiaomei的弟弟。(Zhè shì shénme yǎnchū de yāoqǐngkǎ? — Xuéxiào de yǎnchū. / Xīngqī jǐ? — Xīngqīliù. / Jǐ diǎn kāishǐ? — Wǎnshang qī diǎn. / Shéi yí gè rén dǎ gǔ? — Xiaomei de dìdi.)Phương án nhiễu: 公寓 / 厨房 / 水龙头. 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng thẻ tranh nhạc cụ của phần tiếng Anh: rối Leo nói play the piano / play the violin / play the drums, rối Xiaomei nói 弹钢琴 / 拉小提琴 / 打鼓 (tán gāngqín / lā xiǎotíqín / dǎ gǔ); con phát hiện: tiếng Anh dùng một động từ play, tiếng Trung mỗi nhạc cụ một động từ; She plays beautifully. ↔ 她拉得很好听。(cách thức: -ly cuối câu ↔ 得 + tính từ). 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Con đọc thiệp mời tiếng Anh (Come to our school concert! Saturday, 7 p.m. / Drum solo: Xiaomei's brother / Tickets: free), nói lại ý chính cho bạn chỉ hiểu tiếng Trung: 星期六晚上七点学校有演出，弟弟打鼓，票不要钱。(Xīngqīliù wǎnshang qī diǎn xuéxiào yǒu yǎnchū, dìdi dǎ gǔ, piào bú yào qián.)
column19: 学校的演出 — Xiaomei收到一个信封，里面有一张邀请卡：“星期六晚上七点，来看我们学校的演出吧！”演出的时候，有钢琴、小提琴、鼓，还有很大的低音提琴。同学们先一起合奏，很好听。然后弟弟打鼓，打得非常好！最后，Anna拉小提琴，拉得很好听。妈妈说：“今天的演出真精彩！”(Xiaomei shōudào yí gè xìnfēng, lǐmiàn yǒu yì zhāng yāoqǐngkǎ: “Xīngqīliù wǎnshang qī diǎn, lái kàn wǒmen xuéxiào de yǎnchū ba!” Yǎnchū de shíhou, yǒu gāngqín, xiǎotíqín, gǔ, hái yǒu hěn dà de dīyīn tíqín. Tóngxuémen xiān yìqǐ hézòu, hěn hǎotīng. Ránhòu dìdi dǎ gǔ, dǎ de fēicháng hǎo! Zuìhòu, Anna lā xiǎotíqín, lā de hěn hǎotīng. Māma shuō: “Jīntiān de yǎnchū zhēn jīngcǎi!”)
column20: 一起来演奏 (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb, như bài tiếng Anh) — Leo打鼓打得好，打得好，打得好。Leo打鼓打得好，咚咚咚！Anna拉小提琴，拉小提琴，拉小提琴。Anna拉得真好听！快来一起拉一曲，拉一曲，拉一曲。快来一起拉一曲，学校的演出！(Leo dǎ gǔ dǎ de hǎo, dǎ de hǎo, dǎ de hǎo. Leo dǎ gǔ dǎ de hǎo, dōng dōng dōng! Anna lā xiǎotíqín, lā xiǎotíqín, lā xiǎotíqín. Anna lā de zhēn hǎotīng! Kuài lái yìqǐ lā yì qǔ, lā yì qǔ, lā yì qǔ. Kuài lái yìqǐ lā yì qǔ, xuéxiào de yǎnchū!)

column5: The Invitation — Xiaomei lives on the fifth floor. Today she gets an envelope. Inside, there is an invitation and two tickets for the school concert on Saturday at seven p.m. Her brother is playing a drum solo! 'How much are the tickets?' asks Xiaomei. 'They're free. They're from the school!' says Mum.

column8: Mới: 两张票 liǎng zhāng piào / 今晚的演出 jīnwǎn de yǎnchū / 一共多少钱 yígòng duōshao qián / 一万人 yí wàn rén | Nghe làm quen: 学校演出的邀请卡 xuéxiào yǎnchū de yāoqǐngkǎ / 一个人打鼓 yí gè rén dǎ gǔ
column9: [Cầu nối] I've got two tickets for tonight's show. ↔ 我有两张今晚演出的票。(Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhāng jīnwǎn yǎnchū de piào.) · giống: two ↔ 两 + đồ vật · khác: two tickets (-s) ↔ 两张票 (cần lượng từ 张, 票 không đổi); for tonight's show đứng sau ↔ 今晚演出的 đứng trước 票 / [Ngữ pháp: 一共 + số lượng] 我有两张今晚演出的票。(Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhāng jīnwǎn yǎnchū de piào.) / 这是我们学校演出的邀请卡。(Zhè shì wǒmen xuéxiào yǎnchū de yāoqǐngkǎ.) / 弟弟一个人打鼓，打得很好。(Dìdi yí gè rén dǎ gǔ, dǎ de hěn hǎo.) / 演出晚上七点开始。(Yǎnchū wǎnshang qī diǎn kāishǐ.) / 两张票一共多少钱？——不要钱，是学校送的！(Liǎng zhāng piào yígòng duōshao qián? — Bú yào qián, shì xuéxiào sòng de!) / 今天有一万人来看演出。(Jīntiān yǒu yí wàn rén lái kàn yǎnchū.)
column10: 信封里的票 — Xiaomei住在五楼。今天她收到一个信封。信封里有一张邀请卡和两张票！是学校星期六晚上七点的演出。弟弟要一个人打鼓！Xiaomei问妈妈：“两张票一共多少钱？”妈妈笑着说：“不要钱，是学校送的！”(Xiaomei zhù zài wǔ lóu. Jīntiān tā shōudào yí gè xìnfēng. Xìnfēng lǐ yǒu yì zhāng yāoqǐngkǎ hé liǎng zhāng piào! Shì xuéxiào xīngqīliù wǎnshang qī diǎn de yǎnchū. Dìdi yào yí gè rén dǎ gǔ! Xiaomei wèn māma: “Liǎng zhāng piào yígòng duōshao qián?” Māma xiàozhe shuō: “Bú yào qián, shì xuéxiào sòng de!”)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: trạng từ chỉ cách thức] The actors performed very well. / The actress is singing beautifully on the stage. / He is wearing a wonderful costume. / Do you like Beijing Opera? / The actors help each other. / After the show, the actors welcome their guests.
column5: At the Theatre — Leo and Dad take the lift to the theatre. Tonight they are watching Beijing Opera. On the stage, a famous actor is wearing a wonderful costume. The actress sings beautifully. The actors performed very well. After the show, Dad tells Leo the story of the opera. Leo is surprised. 'Beijing Opera is very interesting!'

column7: Mới: 演员 yǎnyuán (= actor, actress), 讲 jiǎng (= tell a story), 互相 hùxiāng (= each other), 招待 zhāodài (= welcome guests) | Ôn (từ nối Unit 5): 搞笑片 gǎoxiàopiàn, 有趣 yǒuqù, 有名 yǒumíng, 惊奇 jīngqí | Ôn nhanh: 电梯 diàntī
column8: Mới: 有名的演员 yǒumíng de yǎnyuán / 讲故事 jiǎng gùshi / 互相帮助 hùxiāng bāngzhù / 招待客人 zhāodài kèrén / 演得很精彩 yǎn de hěn jīngcǎi
column9: [Cầu nối] The actors performed very well. ↔ 演员们演得很精彩。(Yǎnyuánmen yǎn de hěn jīngcǎi.) · giống: actors (số nhiều) ↔ 演员们 · khác: -s ↔ 们 (chỉ dùng cho người); very well ↔ 得很精彩; help each other ↔ 互相帮助 / [Ngữ pháp: bổ ngữ trạng thái 得] 演员们演得很精彩。(Yǎnyuánmen yǎn de hěn jīngcǎi.) / 你喜欢京剧吗？(Nǐ xǐhuan jīngjù ma?) / 演员们互相帮助。(Yǎnyuánmen hùxiāng bāngzhù.) / 爸爸给我讲京剧的故事。(Bàba gěi wǒ jiǎng jīngjù de gùshi.) / 女演员唱得很好听。(Nǚ yǎnyuán chàng de hěn hǎotīng.) / 他穿着很漂亮的戏服。(Tā chuānzhe hěn piàoliang de xìfú.) / 演出以后，演员们招待客人。(Yǎnchū yǐhòu, yǎnyuánmen zhāodài kèrén.)
column10: 看京剧 — Leo和爸爸坐电梯去看京剧。台上有一个有名的演员，他穿着很漂亮的戏服。女演员唱得很好听。演员们演得很精彩。看完以后，爸爸给Leo讲京剧的故事。Leo很惊奇：“京剧真有趣！”(Leo hé bàba zuò diàntī qù kàn jīngjù. Tái shang yǒu yí gè yǒumíng de yǎnyuán, tā chuānzhe hěn piàoliang de xìfú. Nǚ yǎnyuán chàng de hěn hǎotīng. Yǎnyuánmen yǎn de hěn jīngcǎi. Kàn wán yǐhòu, bàba gěi Leo jiǎng jīngjù de gùshi. Leo hěn jīngqí: “Jīngjù zhēn yǒuqù!”)

column13: Mới: actor, actress, costume, stage (theatre), speak, conversation, borrow, keep | Ôn: cartoon, comedy, interesting, surprise, magazine, telephone, worried, p.m. (for time), glove
column14: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Welcome, everyone! 欢迎大家！" · Chuyển ý: "Now, it's your turn. 现在轮到你了。" · Khen: "Wonderful acting! 演得真精彩！" · Nhắc: "Wait for your turn, please. 请等一等。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): costume, stage / 招待, 互相 1) Đọc định nghĩa, viết từ (dạng Flyers Reading Part 1, 5 câu): This man acts in films or plays. (actor) / This woman acts in films or plays. (actress) / You wear this in a play. (costume) / Actors stand on this in a theatre. (stage) / You do this when you use your friend's thing for a short time. (borrow) 2) Chọn câu trả lời đúng (dạng Flyers Reading Part 2, 4 câu): Can I borrow your violin? – (Sure! / Yes, I do.) / Do you like Beijing Opera? – (Yes, I love it! / It's on Saturday.) / How well does she speak Chinese? – (Very well. / She is ten.) / What's on TV tonight? – (A comedy. / I'm sure.) 3) Đóng vai ở nhà hát: Excuse me, where's the stage? – It's over there. / The actors performed very well! – Yes, they did! 4) Flyers Nói phần 2 (mẫu) – trao đổi thông tin về 2 buổi hòa nhạc (cô là giám khảo; cô có thẻ 'Leo's concert', con có thẻ 'Anna's concert'): Con hỏi: Where is Leo's concert? – At the theatre. / When is it? – On Saturday at 7 p.m. / What instrument does Leo play? – The drums. / How much is a ticket? – 50 yuan. / Is it interesting? – Yes, it's wonderful! Cô hỏi về thẻ của con: Where is Anna's concert? – In the park. / What time is it? – At 4 p.m. / What does Anna play? – The violin. / Who are the actors? – Her classmates. / Can you borrow a costume? – Yes, you can. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Rối Xiaomei kể truyện tiếng Trung '台上的Nhan'; con tóm tắt cho rối Leo bằng 2–3 câu tiếng Anh: Nhan can't find his costume and he's worried. Another actor finds it behind the stage. The play is very funny.
column15: Behind the Stage — Nhan is an actor in the school play. Before the play, he can't find his costume! He is very worried. He speaks to his friend Anna. 'Can I borrow your hat?' 'Sure,' says Anna. 'But please keep it carefully.' Then the actress in the play finds his costume behind the stage. What a surprise! The play is a comedy. Nhan and the actress have a funny conversation on the stage. Everyone laughs. 'The actors performed very well!' says the teacher.
column16: On the Stage (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Actors, actors on the stage, / In your costumes, what a show! / You speak well and you sing well, / You perform so beautifully! / Actors, actors on the stage, / Thank you for a wonderful show!
column17: Mới: 演员 yǎnyuán, 借 jiè | Ôn: 说 shuō, 聊天 liáotiān, 放好 fànghǎo, 卡通片 kǎtōngpiàn, 搞笑片 gǎoxiàopiàn, 有趣 yǒuqù, 惊奇 jīngqí, 杂志 zázhì, 电话 diànhuà, 担心 dānxīn, 下午 xiàwǔ, 手套 shǒutào | Nghe làm quen: 演出服 yǎnchūfú, 舞台 wǔtái
column18: 1) Đọc và chọn từ điền vào chỗ trống (dạng YCT4 đọc – chọn từ, 5 câu): 他是一个很有名的___。(演员) / 爸爸给我___京剧的故事。(讲) / 同学们要___帮助。(互相) / 我可以___你的小提琴吗？(借) / 演出以后，演员们___客人。(招待) Phương án nhiễu: 打折 / 网购 / 领带. 2) Nói theo tranh với bổ ngữ 得 (3 câu): 演员们演得很精彩。/ 他讲得很清楚。/ 妈妈招待客人招待得很好。 3) Đóng vai ở nhà hát (như bài 3 tiếng Anh): 请问，舞台在哪儿？——在那儿。/ 演员们演得很精彩！——是啊！/ 你喜欢京剧吗？——喜欢，京剧很有趣！/ 我可以借你的小提琴吗？——可以。 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh sân khấu 'Behind the Stage': The actors performed very well. ↔ 演员们演得很精彩。/ Can I borrow your hat? ↔ 我可以借你的帽子吗？(Yǎnyuánmen yǎn de hěn jīngcǎi. / Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de màozi ma?); con so sánh: -s ↔ 们 (chỉ người), Can I …? ↔ 我可以……吗？
column19: 台上的Nhan — Nhan是学校演出的演员。演出以前，他找不到他的演出服，很担心。他跟好朋友Anna说：“我可以借你的帽子吗？”Anna说：“可以！可是请你放好。”这时候，演出里的女演员在台后面找到了他的演出服。大家都很惊奇！这是一个搞笑的演出。在台上，Nhan和女演员说了很多好笑的话，大家都笑了。老师说：“演员们演得很精彩！”(Nhan shì xuéxiào yǎnchū de yǎnyuán. Yǎnchū yǐqián, tā zhǎo bu dào tā de yǎnchūfú, hěn dānxīn. Tā gēn hǎo péngyou Anna shuō: “Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de màozi ma?” Anna shuō: “Kěyǐ! Kěshì qǐng nǐ fànghǎo.” Zhè shíhou, yǎnchū lǐ de nǚ yǎnyuán zài tái hòumiàn zhǎodàole tā de yǎnchūfú. Dàjiā dōu hěn jīngqí! Zhè shì yí gè gǎoxiào de yǎnchū. Zài tái shang, Nhan hé nǚ yǎnyuán shuōle hěn duō hǎoxiào de huà, dàjiā dōu xiào le. Lǎoshī shuō: “Yǎnyuánmen yǎn de hěn jīngcǎi!”)
column20: 台上的小演员 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, như bài tiếng Anh) — 小演员们在台上，穿着漂亮演出服。说得好来唱得好，演得真是很精彩！小演员们在台上，谢谢你们的演出！(Xiǎo yǎnyuánmen zài tái shang, chuānzhe piàoliang yǎnchūfú. Shuō de hǎo lái chàng de hǎo, yǎn de zhēn shì hěn jīngcǎi! Xiǎo yǎnyuánmen zài tái shang, xièxie nǐmen de yǎnchū!)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: trạng từ chỉ cách thức] Can I borrow your violin? – Sure! / Please keep it carefully. / She speaks Chinese very well. / We have a conversation on the telephone every Sunday.
column5: Borrowing a Violin — Nhan wants to play in the concert, but he hasn't got a violin. He calls Anna on the telephone. They have a short conversation. 'Can I borrow your violin?' 'Sure,' says Anna. 'But please keep it carefully.' Nhan is a little worried, so he keeps it in a big box. After the concert, he gives it back. 'Thank you! I played well!'

column7: Mới: 借 jiè (= borrow) | Ôn (từ nối Unit 5): 杂志 zázhì, 报纸 bàozhǐ, 电话 diànhuà, 联系 liánxì, 担心 dānxīn | Ôn nhanh: 手套 shǒutào
column8: Mới: 借小提琴 jiè xiǎotíqín / 借给我 jiè gěi wǒ | Ôn: 放好 fànghǎo / 说中文 shuō Zhōngwén / 在电话里聊天 zài diànhuà lǐ liáotiān
column9: [Cầu nối] Can I borrow your violin? – Sure! ↔ 我可以借你的小提琴吗？——可以！(Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de xiǎotíqín ma? — Kěyǐ!) · giống: I – borrow – your violin · khác: tiếng Anh đưa Can lên đầu câu hỏi ↔ tiếng Trung giữ trật tự, thêm 吗 cuối câu; trả lời ngắn lặp lại 可以 / [Ngữ pháp: bổ ngữ trạng thái 得] 我可以借你的小提琴吗？——可以！(Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de xiǎotíqín ma? — Kěyǐ!) / 请你把它放好。(Qǐng nǐ bǎ tā fànghǎo.) / 她说中文说得很好。(Tā shuō Zhōngwén shuō de hěn hǎo.) / Nhan给Anna打电话。(Nhan gěi Anna dǎ diànhuà.) / 我们每个星期天在电话里聊天。(Wǒmen měi gè xīngqītiān zài diànhuà lǐ liáotiān.) / [Chuyển ngữ] Con nghe truyện tiếng Anh 'Borrowing a Violin', nói lại ý chính cho Xiaomei bằng 2 câu tiếng Trung (ghi âm): Nhan没有小提琴，他给Anna打电话，借了她的小提琴。演出以后，他把小提琴还给Anna。(Nhan méiyǒu xiǎotíqín, tā gěi Anna dǎ diànhuà, jièle tā de xiǎotíqín. Yǎnchū yǐhòu, tā bǎ xiǎotíqín huán gěi Anna.)
column10: 借小提琴 — Nhan想参加演出，可是他没有小提琴。他给Anna打电话，他们聊了一会儿。“我可以借你的小提琴吗？”Anna说：“可以！可是请你放好。”Nhan有一点儿担心，就把小提琴放在一个大盒子里。演出以后，他把小提琴还给Anna：“谢谢你！我拉得很好！”(Nhan xiǎng cānjiā yǎnchū, kěshì tā méiyǒu xiǎotíqín. Tā gěi Anna dǎ diànhuà, tāmen liáole yíhuìr. “Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de xiǎotíqín ma?” Anna shuō: “Kěyǐ! Kěshì qǐng nǐ fànghǎo.” Nhan yǒu yìdiǎnr dānxīn, jiù bǎ xiǎotíqín fàng zài yí gè dà hézi lǐ. Yǎnchū yǐhòu, tā bǎ xiǎotíqín huán gěi Anna: “Xièxie nǐ! Wǒ lā de hěn hǎo!”)

column1: Ngày 53. Unit 6 · Cây đàn nặng ơi là nặng
column2: Mới: push, hate, else | Ôn nhanh: September, glove | Ôn: drum, concert, invitation, piano
column3: Mới: push the piano / What else? / Who else? | Ôn: a drum solo / on the stage
column4: [Ngữ pháp: trạng từ chỉ cách thức + từ chức năng a few, no-one] Can you push the piano, please? / I hate loud music, but I love quiet tunes. / We can play a few songs. / No-one can play the drums as well as Leo. / The piano is two hundred kilos. It's very heavy! / What else can you play?
column5: The Heavy Piano — It's the day of the concert. The piano isn't on the stage. It's very heavy – two hundred kilos! 'Can someone push it?' asks the teacher. No-one moves. Then Leo and a few friends push it together. 'What else can we do?' asks Leo. 'You can play a few songs!' says the teacher. Leo hates waiting, so he plays the drums at once!
column6: Tìm YouTube: "a few no-one grammar for kids"
column7: Mới: 除了 chúle (= besides … else), 讨厌 tǎoyàn (= hate), 地 de (= -ly: slowly, happily), 公斤 gōngjīn (= kilo, tranh cái cân) | Ôn nhanh: 九月 jiǔyuè, 手套 shǒutào | Ôn: 钢琴 gāngqín, 鼓 gǔ, 演出 yǎnchū
column8: Mới: 除了……以外 chúle……yǐwài / 讨厌等 tǎoyàn děng / 慢慢地推 mànman de tuī / 马上打鼓 mǎshàng dǎ gǔ / 两百公斤 liǎng bǎi gōngjīn | Ôn: 几个同学 jǐ gè tóngxué / 没有人 méiyǒu rén
column9: [Cầu nối] Leo and a few friends push the piano slowly. ↔ Leo和几个同学慢慢地推钢琴。(Leo hé jǐ gè tóngxué mànman de tuī gāngqín.) · giống: a few ↔ 几个 · khác: slowly (-ly) sau động từ ↔ 慢慢地 trước động từ; What else can we do? ↔ 我们还能做什么？(Wǒmen hái néng zuò shénme?) — 还 ↔ else; 除了……以外，还…… dùng khi đã nói một thứ: What else can you play? ↔ 除了钢琴以外，你还会什么？ / [Ngữ pháp: tính từ + 地 + động từ; 除了……以外，还……] 除了钢琴以外，我还会打鼓。(Chúle gāngqín yǐwài, wǒ hái huì dǎ gǔ.) / 我讨厌很大的声音。(Wǒ tǎoyàn hěn dà de shēngyīn.) / 他们一起慢慢地推钢琴。(Tāmen yìqǐ mànman de tuī gāngqín.) / 钢琴有两百公斤，很重！(Gāngqín yǒu liǎng bǎi gōngjīn, hěn zhòng!) / 我们可以演奏几首曲子。(Wǒmen kěyǐ yǎnzòu jǐ shǒu qǔzi.) / 没有人打鼓打得像Leo那么好。(Méiyǒu rén dǎ gǔ dǎ de xiàng Leo nàme hǎo.)
column10: 很重的钢琴 — 今天有演出。钢琴不在台上，它很重，有两百公斤！老师问：“谁能推一推？”没有人动。然后，Leo和几个同学一起慢慢地推钢琴。Leo问：“我们还能做什么？”老师说：“你们可以演奏几首曲子！”Leo讨厌等，他马上打鼓。(Jīntiān yǒu yǎnchū. Gāngqín bú zài tái shang, tā hěn zhòng, yǒu liǎng bǎi gōngjīn! Lǎoshī wèn: “Shéi néng tuī yi tuī?” Méiyǒu rén dòng. Ránhòu, Leo hé jǐ gè tóngxué yìqǐ mànman de tuī gāngqín. Leo wèn: “Wǒmen hái néng zuò shénme?” Lǎoshī shuō: “Nǐmen kěyǐ yǎnzòu jǐ shǒu qǔzi!” Leo tǎoyàn děng, tā mǎshàng dǎ gǔ.)

column15: The Heavy Piano — It's the day of the big concert. The piano isn't on the stage. It's very heavy – two hundred kilos! 'Can someone push it?' asks the teacher. No-one moves. Then Leo and a few friends push it slowly together. 'What else can we do?' asks Leo. 'Can you play a few songs before the concert?' says the teacher. Leo hates waiting, so he plays the drums at once. The composer of the concert songs is there too. He smiles. 'This boy plays very well!'
column16: No-One Plays Like You (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat) — Push, push, push the piano, push it to the stage! / A few friends and you and me, push it all the way! / Play, play, play a tune, play it very well! / No-one plays the drums like you, ring the concert bell!

column18: 1) Chọn từ đúng (như bài 1 tiếng Anh, 3 câu): (几个 / 没有人) 同学帮Leo推钢琴。(几个) / (没有人 / 几个) 打鼓打得像Leo那么好。(没有人) / 我 (讨厌 / 借) 很大的声音。(讨厌) · Hoàn thành câu với 除了……以外，还…… (3 câu): 除了钢琴以外，我还会___。/ 除了唱歌以外，Anna还会___。/ 除了Leo以外，还有谁打鼓？ 2) Chọn 的 / 地 / 得 (4 câu): 大家高兴___唱歌。(地) / 他唱___非常好。(得) / 我___小提琴很旧。(的) / 弟弟慢慢___走。(地) 3) Ôn không tranh – nghe mô tả, nói từ (5 câu, như bài 2 tiếng Anh): 很大，你用手打它。(鼓) / 黑色和白色，你用手指弹它。(钢琴) / 很小，你拉它，声音很好听。(小提琴) / 钢琴很重，有两百___。(公斤) / 去演出以前，你会收到它。(票 / 邀请卡) 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng 4 tranh 'The Heavy Piano': Leo and a few friends push it slowly. ↔ Leo和几个同学慢慢地推钢琴。(Leo hé jǐ gè tóngxué mànman de tuī gāngqín.); con tìm: a few ↔ 几个, slowly (-ly sau động từ) ↔ 慢慢地 (trước động từ); What else can you play? ↔ 除了钢琴以外，你们还会什么？ 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Rối Leo kể truyện tiếng Anh 'The Heavy Piano'; con tóm tắt cho rối Xiaomei bằng 2 câu tiếng Trung: 钢琴很重，Leo和几个同学一起推。然后Leo马上打鼓，打得很好。(Gāngqín hěn zhòng, Leo hé jǐ gè tóngxué yìqǐ tuī. Ránhòu Leo mǎshàng dǎ gǔ, dǎ de hěn hǎo.)
column19: 很重的钢琴 — 今天有一个很大的演出。钢琴不在台上，它有两百公斤，很重！老师问：“谁能推一推？”没有人动。然后，Leo和几个同学一起慢慢地推钢琴。Leo问：“我们还能做什么？”老师说：“演出以前，你们可以演奏几首曲子吗？”Leo讨厌等，他马上高兴地打鼓。作曲家也在那儿，他笑着说：“这个孩子打得真好！”(Jīntiān yǒu yí gè hěn dà de yǎnchū. Gāngqín bú zài tái shang, tā yǒu liǎng bǎi gōngjīn, hěn zhòng! Lǎoshī wèn: “Shéi néng tuī yi tuī?” Méiyǒu rén dòng. Ránhòu, Leo hé jǐ gè tóngxué yìqǐ mànman de tuī gāngqín. Leo wèn: “Wǒmen hái néng zuò shénme?” Lǎoshī shuō: “Yǎnchū yǐqián, nǐmen kěyǐ yǎnzòu jǐ shǒu qǔzi ma?” Leo tǎoyàn děng, tā mǎshàng gāoxìng de dǎ gǔ. Zuòqǔjiā yě zài nàr, tā xiàozhe shuō: “Zhège háizi dǎ de zhēn hǎo!”)
column20: 推钢琴 (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat, như bài tiếng Anh) — 推，推，推钢琴，推到台上去！几个朋友和你我，一起推过去！弹，弹，弹一曲，弹得真好听！谁打鼓也没你打得好，演出开始啦！(Tuī, tuī, tuī gāngqín, tuī dào tái shang qù! Jǐ gè péngyou hé nǐ wǒ, yìqǐ tuī guòqù! Tán, tán, tán yì qǔ, tán de zhēn hǎotīng! Shéi dǎ gǔ yě méi nǐ dǎ de hǎo, yǎnchū kāishǐ la!)

column15: The Rainbow Concert — Leo has got a problem. The school concert is tonight, but his drum is broken. 'I need a drum from somewhere!' he says. Xiaomei speaks to her uncle on the telephone. He has got an old drum and Leo can borrow it. Outside it's only fifteen degrees, but the hall is warm and comfortable. In the evening, there is a rainbow over the school. Anna plays a violin solo beautifully, Nhan is an actor in a funny costume and Leo plays the drums very well. After the concert, Leo says to Xiaomei's uncle, 'Thank you! I kept your drum safe.' 'You played very well!' says the uncle.

column9: [Cầu nối] Why do you like swimming? – Because swimming is good for my health. ↔ 你为什么喜欢游泳？——因为游泳对身体很好。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yóuyǒng? — Yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) · giống: Because ↔ 因为 đứng đầu câu trả lời · khác: Why đứng đầu câu ↔ 为什么 đứng sau 你; bike race ↔ 自行车比赛 (race ↔ 比赛) / [Ngữ pháp: 为什么……？——因为……] 你为什么喜欢游泳？(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yóuyǒng?) / 因为游泳对身体很好。(Yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) / 你为什么喜欢自行车比赛？——因为很快，很有意思。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan zìxíngchē bǐsài? — Yīnwèi hěn kuài, hěn yǒu yìsi.) / 几比几？——二比一。(Jǐ bǐ jǐ? — Èr bǐ yī.) / 我每天早上骑自行车上学。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qí zìxíngchē shàngxué.) / 我的自行车轮胎没气了。——比赛以前我们修一修吧。(Wǒ de zìxíngchē lúntāi méi qì le. — Bǐsài yǐqián wǒmen xiū yi xiū ba.)
column10: 自行车比赛 — 星期天，公园里有自行车比赛。Anna问Leo：“你为什么喜欢自行车比赛？”Leo说：“因为很快，很有意思！”Leo骑得很快。天气很冷，可是他不停。他得了第一！比赛以后，爸爸开车送他回家。(Xīngqītiān, gōngyuán lǐ yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài. Anna wèn Leo: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan zìxíngchē bǐsài?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi hěn kuài, hěn yǒu yìsi!” Leo qí de hěn kuài. Tiānqì hěn lěng, kěshì tā bù tíng. Tā déle dì-yī! Bǐsài yǐhòu, bàba kāichē sòng tā huí jiā.)

column14: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon! Let's talk about sports. 我们说说运动吧。" · Chuyển ý: "Ready, steady, go! 预备——开始！" · Khen: "Fantastic! 真厉害！" · Nhắc: "Stand in a line, please. 请排好队。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): score, gymnastics / 体育馆 1) Nghe và nối tên với môn thể thao (dạng Flyers Listening Part 1, 5 người): Leo – bike racing / Xiaomei – gymnastics / Grandpa – golf / Nhan – chess / Anna – badminton. 2) Ghép câu hỏi Why với câu trả lời Because (4 cặp): Why do you like swimming? – Because it's good for my health. / Why does Grandpa play golf? – Because it's quiet. / Why do you like chess? – Because it makes me think. / Why is Leo happy? – Because he won the race. 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp với can: Can you play chess? – Yes, I can. / No, I can't. / I can play badminton, but I can't play tennis. Phương án nhiễu trong tranh: fork / knife / shelf. 4) Flyers Nói phần 3 (mẫu) – kể truyện theo 5 tranh 'The Flat Tyre' (cô là giám khảo, kể tranh 1; con kể tranh 2–5): Tranh 1 (cô): It's Sunday. Leo is ready for the bike race in the park. / Tranh 2: Oh no! His bike has got a flat tyre. Leo is sad. / Tranh 3: He can't race without a good tyre, so his coach helps him. / Tranh 4: They fix the tyre quickly and Leo cycles very fast. / Tranh 5: Leo comes first! Dad gives him a lift home in the car.
column15: Sports Week — It's Sports Week at Leo's school. On Monday, there is a bike race. Leo cycles very fast and wins! On Tuesday, there is a football match. 'What's the score?' asks Dad. 'Three–two to our team!' On Wednesday, Xiaomei does gymnastics with her coach in the sports hall. On Thursday, her brother does a kung fu show. On Friday, Nhan plays table tennis with the teacher – and Grandpa teaches golf and chess. 'Why do you like Sports Week?' asks Mum. 'Because we can try a different sport every day!' says Leo.
column16: Why Do You Like It? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — Why do you like it? Why do you like it? / Swimming? Swimming? / Because it's good for me, because it's good for me, / Every day! Every day!
column17: Mới: 比赛 bǐsài, 体育馆 tǐyùguǎn, 打 dǎ, 体操 tǐcāo, 功夫 gōngfu, 表演 biǎoyǎn, 感兴趣 gǎn xìngqù | Ôn: 踢足球 tī zúqiú, 打篮球 dǎ lánqiú, 羽毛球 yǔmáoqiú, 网球 wǎngqiú, 骑自行车 qí zìxíngchē, 空气 kōngqì, 睡衣 shuìyī | Nghe làm quen: 教练 jiàoliàn, 下棋 xiàqí, 高尔夫球 gāo'ěrfūqiú, 曲棍球 qūgùnqiú, 轮胎 lúntāi
column18: 1) Nghe và nối tên với môn thể thao (như bài 1 tiếng Anh, 5 người): Leo – 自行车比赛 / Xiaomei – 做体操 / 爷爷 – 打高尔夫球 / Nhan – 下棋 / Anna – 打羽毛球 (con nghe rồi nối; 高尔夫球, 下棋 chỉ nghe hiểu). 2) Ghép 为什么 với 因为 (3 cặp): 你为什么喜欢游泳？– 因为游泳对身体很好。/ 爷爷为什么喜欢下棋？– 因为下棋让他想很多。/ Leo为什么很高兴？– 因为他赢了比赛。 3) Phân biệt 会 / 能 / 可以 – chọn từ đúng (4 câu): 你___打羽毛球吗？(会) / 我今天很累，不___跑步。(能) / 这里不___游泳。(可以) / 他___功夫，表演得很好。(会) Phương án nhiễu: 卧室 / 浴缸 / 走廊. 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng bảng 'Sports Week': Why do you like Sports Week? – Because we can try a different sport every day! ↔ 你为什么喜欢体育周？——因为每天都可以玩不一样的运动！(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan tǐyù zhōu? — Yīnwèi měi tiān dōu kěyǐ wán bù yíyàng de yùndòng!); con nhận xét: Why ↔ 为什么 (đứng sau chủ ngữ), Because ↔ 因为; play football ↔ 踢足球, play tennis ↔ 打网球. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Con đọc bảng 'Sports Week' tiếng Anh (Monday – bike race / Tuesday – football match / Wednesday – gymnastics / Thursday – kung fu show / Friday – table tennis), nói lại ý chính cho bạn chỉ hiểu tiếng Trung: 星期一有自行车比赛，星期二有足球比赛，星期三做体操，星期四有功夫表演。(Xīngqīyī yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài, xīngqī'èr yǒu zúqiú bǐsài, xīngqīsān zuò tǐcāo, xīngqīsì yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn.)
column19: 体育周 — 这个星期是学校的体育周。星期一有自行车比赛，Leo骑得很快，得了第一！星期二有足球比赛。爸爸问：“几比几？”“三比二，我们赢了！”星期三，Xiaomei和教练在体育馆做体操。星期四，她哥哥有功夫表演。星期五，Nhan和老师打乒乓球，爷爷教大家打高尔夫球和下棋。妈妈问：“你为什么喜欢体育周？”Leo说：“因为每天都可以玩不一样的运动！”(Zhège xīngqī shì xuéxiào de tǐyù zhōu. Xīngqīyī yǒu zìxíngchē bǐsài, Leo qí de hěn kuài, déle dì-yī! Xīngqī'èr yǒu zúqiú bǐsài. Bàba wèn: “Jǐ bǐ jǐ?” “Sān bǐ èr, wǒmen yíng le!” Xīngqīsān, Xiaomei hé jiàoliàn zài tǐyùguǎn zuò tǐcāo. Xīngqīsì, tā gēge yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn. Xīngqīwǔ, Nhan hé lǎoshī dǎ pīngpāngqiú, yéye jiāo dàjiā dǎ gāo'ěrfūqiú hé xiàqí. Māma wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan tǐyù zhōu?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi měi tiān dōu kěyǐ wán bù yíyàng de yùndòng!”)
column20: 为什么喜欢 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎 – cùng giai điệu Frère Jacques của bài tiếng Anh) — 为什么呀？为什么呀？游泳呢？游泳呢？因为对身体好，因为对身体好，每天游！每天游！(Wèi shénme ya? Wèi shénme ya? Yóuyǒng ne? Yóuyǒng ne? Yīnwèi duì shēntǐ hǎo, yīnwèi duì shēntǐ hǎo, měi tiān yóu! Měi tiān yóu!)

column9: [Cầu nối] I can play badminton, but I can't play tennis. ↔ 我会打羽毛球，但是不会打网球。(Wǒ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú, dànshì bú huì dǎ wǎngqiú.) · giống: can / can't ↔ 会 / 不会, but ↔ 但是 · khác: play badminton / tennis ↔ 打 (đánh bằng vợt), play football ↔ 踢足球 (đá bằng chân) / [Ngữ pháp: 会 – kỹ năng học được] 你会功夫吗？——会，我学了两年。(Nǐ huì gōngfu ma? — Huì, wǒ xuéle liǎng nián.) / 我会打羽毛球，但是不会打网球。(Wǒ huì dǎ yǔmáoqiú, dànshì bú huì dǎ wǎngqiú.) / Xiaomei对体操很感兴趣。(Xiaomei duì tǐcāo hěn gǎn xìngqù.) / 今天下午有功夫表演。(Jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn.) / 我们在体育馆打羽毛球。(Wǒmen zài tǐyùguǎn dǎ yǔmáoqiú.) / 你会下棋吗？——会。(Nǐ huì xiàqí ma? — Huì.) / 爷爷，你为什么喜欢下棋？——因为下棋让我想很多。(Yéye, nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan xiàqí? — Yīnwèi xiàqí ràng wǒ xiǎng hěn duō.) / [Chuyển ngữ] Con nghe truyện tiếng Anh 'Xiaomei's Gymnastics', nói lại ý chính cho Xiaomei bằng 2 câu tiếng Trung (ghi âm): Xiaomei每个星期二做体操。她哥哥会功夫，表演得很好。(Xiaomei měi gè xīngqī'èr zuò tǐcāo. Tā gēge huì gōngfu, biǎoyǎn de hěn hǎo.)
column10: Xiaomei的体操 — Xiaomei每个星期二做体操。她的教练很友好。体育馆很干净，里面很凉快。今天，Xiaomei的哥哥有功夫表演。他功夫表演得很好！然后，爷爷和他们一起下棋、打高尔夫球。Xiaomei问：“爷爷，你为什么喜欢下棋？”爷爷说：“因为下棋让我想很多！”(Xiaomei měi gè xīngqī'èr zuò tǐcāo. Tā de jiàoliàn hěn yǒuhǎo. Tǐyùguǎn hěn gānjìng, lǐmiàn hěn liángkuai. Jīntiān, Xiaomei de gēge yǒu gōngfu biǎoyǎn. Tā gōngfu biǎoyǎn de hěn hǎo! Ránhòu, yéye hé tāmen yìqǐ xiàqí, dǎ gāo'ěrfūqiú. Xiaomei wèn: “Yéye, nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan xiàqí?” Yéye shuō: “Yīnwèi xiàqí ràng wǒ xiǎng hěn duō!”)

column5: Snow Holiday — In winter, Anna's family goes to the mountains. There is a lot of snow. First, they climb a small mountain. Anna can ski and ride a horse, but Leo can't. Mum takes lots of photos.

column9: [Cầu nối] Can you ride a horse? ↔ 你会骑马吗？(Nǐ huì qímǎ ma?) · giống: ride ↔ 骑 dùng cho cả ngựa và xe đạp (ride a horse ↔ 骑马, ride a bike ↔ 骑自行车) · khác: Can đứng đầu câu ↔ 会 đứng sau 你, thêm 吗 / [Ngữ pháp: 会 / 能 và 为什么……因为……] 你会滑雪吗？——不会，可是我会坐雪橇。(Nǐ huì huáxuě ma? — Bú huì, kěshì wǒ huì zuò xuěqiāo.) / 你会骑马吗？——会，我骑得很好。(Nǐ huì qímǎ ma? — Huì, wǒ qí de hěn hǎo.) / 你为什么喜欢玩滑雪板？——因为很刺激。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan wán huáxuěbǎn? — Yīnwèi hěn cìjī.) / 我可以借你的滑雪板吗？(Wǒ kěyǐ jiè nǐ de huáxuěbǎn ma?) / 这里不能滑雪。(Zhèlǐ bù néng huáxuě.)
column10: 山上的假期 — 冬天，Anna一家去山上。山上有很多雪。他们先去爬山。Anna会滑雪，也会骑马，可是Leo不会。Leo借了一个雪橇，从山上滑下来。Anna问：“你为什么喜欢坐雪橇？”Leo说：“因为很快！”然后爸爸去玩滑雪板，他倒在雪里了！大家都笑了，一起扔雪球。妈妈照了很多相。(Dōngtiān, Anna yì jiā qù shān shang. Shān shang yǒu hěn duō xuě. Tāmen xiān qù páshān. Anna huì huáxuě, yě huì qímǎ, kěshì Leo bú huì. Leo jièle yí gè xuěqiāo, cóng shān shang huá xiàlái. Anna wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan zuò xuěqiāo?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi hěn kuài!” Ránhòu bàba qù wán huáxuěbǎn, tā dǎo zài xuě lǐ le! Dàjiā dōu xiào le, yìqǐ rēng xuěqiú. Māma zhàole hěn duō xiàng.)

column14: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Brr, it's cold today! 今天真冷！" · Chuyển ý: "Now, it's Chinese time. 现在是中文时间。" · Khen: "Good thinking! 想得很好！" · Nhắc: "Hands up before you speak. 说话以前请举手。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): sledge, snowboard / 坚持 1) Đọc định nghĩa, viết từ (dạng Flyers Reading Part 1, 5 câu): You stand on this and go down the snow. (snowboard) / You sit on this and go down a hill in the snow. (sledge) / You make it with snow and throw it. (snowball) / You put the pieces together to make a picture. (puzzle) / Some people do this with stamps or shells. (collect) 2) Đọc và chọn đáp án (dạng Flyers Reading Part 3, 4 câu): Nhan likes ___ music because it's loud. (rock / pop) / His sister likes ___ music because it's happy. (pop / rock) / You can't ski here. It's ___. (dangerous / delicious) / Can I ___ your snowboard? (borrow / collect) 3) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: Why do you like snowboarding? – Because it's exciting. / What do you collect? – I collect stamps. 4) Flyers Nói phần 4 (mẫu) – câu hỏi về bản thân, chủ đề sở thích (cô là giám khảo, từng em): Now let's talk about your hobbies. What do you collect? – I collect stamps. / Why do you like it? – Because it's interesting. / Which music do you like, pop or rock? – I like pop music. / What do you do in winter? – I play in the snow. / Tell me about your favourite sport. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Rối Xiaomei kể truyện tiếng Trung '山上的假期'; con tóm tắt cho rối Leo bằng 2–3 câu tiếng Anh: Anna's family goes to the mountains in December. Anna can ride a horse, but Leo can't. In the evening, they listen to music.
column15: The Snow Holiday — In December, Anna's family goes on holiday in the mountains. There is snow everywhere. Anna can ski and ride a horse, but Leo can't. Leo borrows a sledge and rides down the hill. 'Why do you like sledging?' asks Anna. 'Because it's fast!' Dad goes snowboarding and falls into the snow. Everyone laughs and throws snowballs. In the evening, they do a big puzzle and listen to pop music. Leo wants rock music, but Mum says, 'No rock music before bed!'
column16: Snowball Song (giai điệu Jingle Bells – dân gian, hết bản quyền) — Snowballs, snowballs, throwing in the snow! / Ski and sledge and snowboard, down the hill we go! / Snowballs, snowballs, it's a lot of fun! / Pop music, rock music, dancing in the sun!
column17: Nghe làm quen: 滑雪 huáxuě, 雪橇 xuěqiāo, 雪球 xuěqiú, 滑雪板 huáxuěbǎn, 拼图 pīntú, 收集邮票 shōují yóupiào, 流行音乐 liúxíng yīnyuè, 摇滚乐 yáogǔnyuè | Mới: 爬山 páshān, 骑马 qímǎ, 照相 zhàoxiàng, 眼镜 yǎnjìng, 提 tí, 坚持 jiānchí | Ôn: 演出 yǎnchū, 演员 yǎnyuán, 借 jiè, 放好 fànghǎo, 讨厌 tǎoyàn, 鼓 gǔ, 小提琴 xiǎotíqín
column18: 1) Nghe và chỉ tranh (như bài 1 tiếng Anh; chỉ nghe hiểu, không chấm): 滑雪板 / 雪橇 / 雪球 / 拼图 / 邮票. 2) Đọc và chọn từ (dạng YCT4 đọc – chọn từ, 5 câu): 姐姐___眼镜。(戴) / 这个包很重，你能___吗？(提) / 我每天___练习打鼓。(坚持) / 我们去山上___吧。(照相) / 你会___吗？——会，我骑得很好。(骑马) 3) Nghe định nghĩa, nói từ (như bài 1 tiếng Anh, 3 câu): 你站在上面，从雪山上滑下来。(滑雪板) / 你坐在上面，从山上滑下来。(雪橇) / 用雪做的，可以扔。(雪球) (Nǐ zhàn zài shàngmiàn, cóng xuěshān shang huá xiàlái. / Nǐ zuò zài shàngmiàn, cóng shān shang huá xiàlái. / Yòng xuě zuò de, kěyǐ rēng.) 4) Hỏi – đáp theo cặp: 你为什么喜欢玩滑雪板？——因为很刺激。/ 你收集什么？——我收集邮票。/ 你会骑马吗？——会 / 不会。/ 你喜欢流行音乐还是摇滚乐？(con chỉ tranh để trả lời) 5) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh 'The Snow Holiday': Anna can ride a horse, but Leo can't. ↔ Anna会骑马，Leo不会。(Anna huì qímǎ, Leo bú huì.); con tìm: can / can't ↔ 会 / 不会, but ↔ dấu phẩy (tiếng Trung có thể bỏ 但是); ride a horse ↔ 骑马, ride a bike ↔ 骑自行车 (cùng một động từ ride ↔ 骑).
column19: 山上的假期 — 十二月，Anna一家去山上过假期。山上到处都是雪。Anna会滑雪，也会骑马，可是Leo不会。Leo借了一个雪橇，从山上滑下来。Anna问：“你为什么喜欢坐雪橇？”Leo说：“因为很快！”爸爸去玩滑雪板，倒在雪里了。大家都笑了，一起扔雪球。晚上，他们一起拼一个很大的拼图，听流行音乐。Leo想听摇滚乐，可是妈妈说：“睡觉以前不听摇滚乐！”(Shí'èryuè, Anna yì jiā qù shān shang guò jiàqī. Shān shang dàochù dōu shì xuě. Anna huì huáxuě, yě huì qímǎ, kěshì Leo bú huì. Leo jièle yí gè xuěqiāo, cóng shān shang huá xiàlái. Anna wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan zuò xuěqiāo?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi hěn kuài!” Bàba qù wán huáxuěbǎn, dǎo zài xuě lǐ le. Dàjiā dōu xiào le, yìqǐ rēng xuěqiú. Wǎnshang, tāmen yìqǐ pīn yí gè hěn dà de pīntú, tīng liúxíng yīnyuè. Leo xiǎng tīng yáogǔnyuè, kěshì māma shuō: “Shuìjiào yǐqián bù tīng yáogǔnyuè!”)
column20: 雪球歌 (giai điệu Jingle Bells, như bài tiếng Anh) — 雪球，雪球，雪里扔雪球！滑雪、雪橇、滑雪板，一起滑下山！雪球，雪球，真的很好玩！流行音乐、摇滚乐，大家一起跳！(Xuěqiú, xuěqiú, xuě lǐ rēng xuěqiú! Huáxuě, xuěqiāo, huáxuěbǎn, yìqǐ huá xià shān! Xuěqiú, xuěqiú, zhēn de hěn hǎowán! Liúxíng yīnyuè, yáogǔnyuè, dàjiā yìqǐ tiào!)

column5: Nhan's Hobbies — Nhan has got lots of hobbies. He collects stamps and he can do a puzzle with a hundred pieces. He plays the drums in a rock band. His sister wears glasses and she likes pop music. 'Why do you like rock music?' she asks. 'Because it's loud and exciting!' Then Nhan carries a big heavy bag from the door. 'You're very strong!' says his sister.

column9: [Cầu nối] His sister wears glasses. ↔ 他的姐姐戴眼镜。(Tā de jiějie dài yǎnjìng.) · giống: wear glasses ↔ 戴眼镜 · khác: tiếng Anh dùng wear cho mọi thứ ↔ tiếng Trung 戴 (kính, đồng hồ, mũ) nhưng 穿 (quần áo, giày); glasses (-es) ↔ 眼镜 không đổi / [Ngữ pháp: 为什么……？——因为……; 能 – khả năng] 你为什么收集邮票？——因为邮票很漂亮。(Nǐ wèi shénme shōují yóupiào? — Yīnwèi yóupiào hěn piàoliang.) / 我喜欢流行音乐，可是哥哥喜欢摇滚乐。(Wǒ xǐhuan liúxíng yīnyuè, kěshì gēge xǐhuan yáogǔnyuè.) / 你会拼这个拼图吗？——会。(Nǐ huì pīn zhège pīntú ma? — Huì.) / 这个包很重，你能提吗？(Zhège bāo hěn zhòng, nǐ néng tí ma?) / 我每天坚持练习打鼓。(Wǒ měi tiān jiānchí liànxí dǎ gǔ.)
column10: Nhan的爱好 — Nhan有很多爱好。他收集邮票，还会拼一百块的拼图。他每天坚持练习，在摇滚乐队里打鼓。他的姐姐戴眼镜，喜欢流行音乐。姐姐问：“你为什么喜欢摇滚乐？”Nhan说：“因为摇滚乐很响，很有意思！”然后，Nhan从门口提进来一个又大又重的包。姐姐说：“你真厉害！”(Nhan yǒu hěn duō àihào. Tā shōují yóupiào, hái huì pīn yì bǎi kuài de pīntú. Tā měi tiān jiānchí liànxí, zài yáogǔn yuèduì lǐ dǎ gǔ. Tā de jiějie dài yǎnjìng, xǐhuan liúxíng yīnyuè. Jiějie wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yáogǔnyuè?” Nhan shuō: “Yīnwèi yáogǔnyuè hěn xiǎng, hěn yǒu yìsi!” Ránhòu, Nhan cóng ménkǒu tí jìnlái yí gè yòu dà yòu zhòng de bāo. Jiějie shuō: “Nǐ zhēn lìhai!”)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: can't – không được phép; Why…? – Because…] You can't swim here. It's dangerous. / Why is Leo at the hospital? – Because he needs an x-ray. / We can sleep in a tent tonight. / I go running every morning. / Don't go camping without a torch!
column5: The Camping Trip — The family is camping near a river. They put up their tent. 'Can we swim in the river?' asks Leo. 'No, you can't swim here. It's dangerous,' says Dad. Leo plays football and falls over. His arm hurts. At the hospital, the doctor gives him an x-ray. 'Don't worry. It isn't broken,' says the doctor. In the evening, they watch a sports programme on Dad's phone in the tent.

column8: Mới: 很危险 hěn wēixiǎn / 体育节目 tǐyù jiémù / 电视节目 diànshì jiémù | Nghe làm quen: 睡在帐篷里 shuì zài zhàngpeng lǐ / 拍X光片 pāi X guāngpiàn | Ôn: 去露营 qù lùyíng
column9: [Cầu nối] You can't swim here. It's dangerous. ↔ 这里不可以游泳，很危险。(Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.) · giống: hai ý: không được – vì nguy hiểm · khác: here cuối câu ↔ 这里 đầu câu; It's dangerous ↔ 很危险 (không cần 是) / [Ngữ pháp: 可以 / 不可以 – được phép] 这里不可以游泳，很危险。(Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.) / 你为什么在医院？——因为我要拍X光片。(Nǐ wèi shénme zài yīyuàn? — Yīnwèi wǒ yào pāi X guāngpiàn.) / 今天晚上我们可以睡在帐篷里。(Jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen kěyǐ shuì zài zhàngpeng lǐ.) / 没有手电筒，不要去露营！(Méiyǒu shǒudiàntǒng, bú yào qù lùyíng!) / 我每天早上跑步。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù.) / 爸爸喜欢看体育节目。(Bàba xǐhuan kàn tǐyù jiémù.)
column10: 去露营 — 一家人在河边露营。他们搭好帐篷。Leo问：“我们可以在河里游泳吗？”爸爸说：“这里不可以游泳，很危险。”Leo去踢足球，摔倒了，胳膊很疼。在医院，医生给他拍了X光片。医生说：“别担心，骨头没有断。”晚上，大家在帐篷里看手机上的体育节目。(Yì jiā rén zài hé biān lùyíng. Tāmen dāhǎo zhàngpeng. Leo wèn: “Wǒmen kěyǐ zài hé lǐ yóuyǒng ma?” Bàba shuō: “Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.” Leo qù tī zúqiú, shuāidǎo le, gēbo hěn téng. Zài yīyuàn, yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn. Yīshēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, gǔtou méiyǒu duàn.” Wǎnshang, dàjiā zài zhàngpeng lǐ kàn shǒujī shang de tǐyù jiémù.)

column15: The Camping Trip — On Saturday, the family goes camping near a river. They put up their tent. 'Can we swim in the river?' asks Leo. 'No, you can't swim here. It's dangerous,' says Dad. So Leo plays football. He runs too fast and falls over. His arm hurts! At the hospital, the doctor gives him an x-ray. 'Don't worry. It isn't broken,' says the doctor. In the evening, they watch a sports programme on Dad's phone in the tent. 'I go running every morning,' says Leo, 'but tomorrow I'm staying in the tent!'

Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn. Leo de gēbo téng, kěshì méi guānxi.)
column19: 去露营 — 星期六，一家人去河边露营。他们搭好帐篷。Leo问：“我们可以在河里游泳吗？”爸爸说：“这里不可以游泳，很危险。”所以Leo去踢足球。他跑得太快，摔倒了，胳膊很疼！在医院，医生给他拍了X光片。医生说：“别担心，骨头没有断。”晚上，大家在帐篷里看爸爸手机上的体育节目。Leo说：“我每天早上跑步，可是明天我要在帐篷里休息！”(Xīngqīliù, yì jiā rén qù hé biān lùyíng. Tāmen dāhǎo zhàngpeng. Leo wèn: “Wǒmen kěyǐ zài hé lǐ yóuyǒng ma?” Bàba shuō: “Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.” Suǒyǐ Leo qù tī zúqiú. Tā pǎo de tài kuài, shuāidǎo le, gēbo hěn téng! Zài yīyuàn, yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn. Yīshēng shuō: “Bié dānxīn, gǔtou méiyǒu duàn.” Wǎnshang, dàjiā zài zhàngpeng lǐ kàn bàba shǒujī shang de tǐyù jiémù. Leo shuō: “Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù, kěshì míngtiān wǒ yào zài zhàngpeng lǐ xiūxi!”)
column20: 露营歌 (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat, như bài tiếng Anh) — 露营，露营，今晚去露营，睡在帐篷里！河里游泳很危险，朋友不要去！跑啊，跑啊，跑得快，足球踢得高！注意安全一起玩，天空蓝又蓝！(Lùyíng, lùyíng, jīnwǎn qù lùyíng, shuì zài zhàngpeng lǐ! Hé lǐ yóuyǒng hěn wēixiǎn, péngyou bú yào qù! Pǎo a, pǎo a, pǎo de kuài, zúqiú tī de gāo! Zhùyì ānquán yìqǐ wán, tiānkōng lán yòu lán!)

column9: [Cầu nối] Can you play football? – Yes, I can. ↔ 你会踢足球吗？——会。(Nǐ huì tī zúqiú ma? — Huì.) · giống: trả lời ngắn lặp lại can ↔ 会 · khác: Yes, I can ↔ chỉ nói 会 (không có từ yes); Korean / Japanese ↔ 韩国 / 日本 / [Ngữ pháp: 为什么……因为…… và 会 / 能 / 可以 – Phiên dịch nhí Trung → Anh] 你为什么喜欢游泳？——因为游泳对身体很好。(Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan yóuyǒng? — Yīnwèi yóuyǒng duì shēntǐ hěn hǎo.) / 你会踢足球吗？(Nǐ huì tī zúqiú ma?) / 我每天早上跑步。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang pǎobù.) / 这里不可以游泳，很危险。(Zhèlǐ bù kěyǐ yóuyǒng, hěn wēixiǎn.)
column10: 小小体育记者 — Anna在学校网站上写体育新闻。她问一个韩国同学：“你为什么喜欢功夫？”他说：“因为功夫很有意思，对身体也很好。”她问一个日本同学：“你会骑马吗？”“会，我每个周末都骑马。”然后，Anna用英文和中文写新闻。(Anna zài xuéxiào wǎngzhàn shang xiě tǐyù xīnwén. Tā wèn yí gè Hánguó tóngxué: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan gōngfu?” Tā shuō: “Yīnwèi gōngfu hěn yǒu yìsi, duì shēntǐ yě hěn hǎo.” Tā wèn yí gè Rìběn tóngxué: “Nǐ huì qímǎ ma?” “Huì, wǒ měi gè zhōumò dōu qímǎ.” Ránhòu, Anna yòng Yīngwén hé Zhōngwén xiě xīnwén.)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: hỏi thăm What's the matter? và khuyên should] What's the matter with you? – I've got a headache. / I've got a cough and a fever. / You should take some medicine. / You should see a doctor. / He injured his knee. There's some blood on it.
column5: Leo Is Ill — Leo doesn't want to get up. 'What's the matter with you?' asks Mum. 'I've got a headache and a cough. My head hurts a lot!' says Leo. Mum takes him to the doctor. 'You've got flu,' says the doctor. 'You should take this medicine and have a rest. You don't need an injection.' 'Thank you, doctor!' 'You're welcome.'

column7: Mới: 头疼 tóuténg (= headache), 咳嗽 késou (= cough), 应该 yīnggāi (= should), 打针 dǎzhēn (= have an injection), 受伤 shòushāng (= get hurt, injure), 受不了 shòu bu liǎo (= hurts too much, tranh) | Nghe làm quen: 流血 liú xiě (= blood), 膝盖 xīgài (= knee) | Ôn nhanh: 不客气 bú kèqi, 网上 wǎng shang | Ôn: 医生 yīshēng, 药 yào, 健康 jiànkāng, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 感冒 gǎnmào
column8: Mới: 我头疼 wǒ tóuténg / 有点儿咳嗽 yǒudiǎnr késou / 应该吃药 yīnggāi chī yào / 去医院打针 qù yīyuàn dǎzhēn / 疼得受不了 téng de shòu bu liǎo / 膝盖受伤了 xīgài shòushāng le | Nghe làm quen: 流了一点儿血 liúle yìdiǎnr xiě
column9: [Cầu nối] You should see a doctor. ↔ 你应该去看医生。(Nǐ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.) · giống: should ↔ 应该 đứng trước động từ · khác: see a doctor ↔ 去看医生 (thêm 去); What's the matter? ↔ 你怎么了？ / [Ngữ pháp: 你怎么了？và 应该 + động từ] 你怎么了？(Nǐ zěnme le?) / 我头疼。(Wǒ tóuténg.) / 我咳嗽，还发烧。(Wǒ késou, hái fāshāo.) / 你应该吃药。(Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào.) / 你应该去看医生。(Nǐ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.) / 我头疼得受不了！(Wǒ tóu téng de shòu bu liǎo!) / 他的膝盖受伤了，流了一点儿血。(Tā de xīgài shòushāng le, liúle yìdiǎnr xiě.)
column10: Leo生病了 — 早上，Leo不想起床。妈妈问：“你怎么了？”Leo说：“我头疼，还咳嗽。头疼得受不了！”妈妈带他去看医生。医生说：“你感冒了，应该吃药，多休息。不用打针。”Leo说：“谢谢医生！”医生说：“不客气。”(Zǎoshang, Leo bù xiǎng qǐchuáng. Māma wèn: “Nǐ zěnme le?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ tóuténg, hái késou. Tóu téng de shòu bu liǎo!” Māma dài tā qù kàn yīshēng. Yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ gǎnmào le, yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi. Bú yòng dǎzhēn.” Leo shuō: “Xièxie yīshēng!” Yīshēng shuō: “Bú kèqi.”)

column12: Buổi dạy 33. Unit 8 · Illness – Ốm đau và sức khỏe (1/4): hỏi thăm, khuyên bảo should / 应该
column13: Mới: medicine, flu, rest, blood, injure, soap, shampoo, soft, lovely, ready | Ôn: stomach-ache, ice cream, doctor, hospital, healthy, check-up, knee, online, you're welcome, pajamas (UK pyjamas)
column14: [Lời cô] Vào bài: "Good afternoon! How are you feeling today? 你们今天身体好吗？" · Chuyển ý: "Let's be doctors. 我们来当医生。" · Khen: "Excellent! 太好了！" · Nhắc: "Wash your hands, please. 请洗手。" · Tiếng Việt: chỉ giữ nề nếp; từ khó hình dung của buổi (cô quyết định có giải nghĩa không): flu, injection, blood / 打针 1) Nghe và chọn A/B/C (dạng Flyers Listening Part 4, 4 câu): What's the matter with Leo? (A flu ✓ / B a broken arm / C a toothache) / What should he take? (A medicine ✓ / B a bath / C a photo) / What does the boy wash his hair with? (A soap / B shampoo ✓ / C water) / What are soft? (A his shoes / B his pyjamas ✓ / C his books) 2) Ghép vấn đề với lời khuyên should / shouldn't (5 cặp): I've got a headache. – You should have a rest. / I've got flu. – You should see a doctor. / My hands are dirty. – You should wash them with soap. / I've got a stomach-ache. – You shouldn't eat ice cream. / I'm tired. – You should go to bed. 3) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân: What's the matter with you? – I've got a cough and a fever. – You should take some medicine. – Thank you, doctor! – You're welcome. Phương án nhiễu trong tranh: necklace / bracelet / sunglasses.
column15: A Busy Day at the Doctor's — Today the doctor is very busy. Leo has got flu. 'You should take this medicine and have a rest,' says the doctor. Xiaomei's brother has got a stomach-ache. 'You shouldn't eat so much ice cream!' Nhan injured his knee and there is a little blood. The nurse washes it with soap and water. 'Are you ready? This won't hurt.' Then she puts on a soft bandage. 'Thank you!' says Nhan. 'You're welcome!' says the nurse. 'Be careful next time!'
column16: What's the Matter? (giai điệu Frère Jacques) — What's the matter? What's the matter? / I've got flu. I've got flu. / You should take some medicine, you should have a rest now, / Get well soon! Get well soon!
column17: Mới: 头疼 tóuténg, 咳嗽 késou, 应该 yīnggāi, 打针 dǎzhēn, 拉肚子 lā dùzi, 受伤 shòushāng, 小心 xiǎoxīn, 流汗 liú hàn, 受不了 shòu bu liǎo | Ôn: 肚子疼 dùzi téng, 医生 yīshēng, 药 yào, 健康 jiànkāng, 体检 tǐjiǎn, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 不客气 bú kèqi, 网上 wǎng shang | Nghe làm quen: 流血 liú xiě, 膝盖 xīgài, 香皂 xiāngzào, 洗发水 xǐfàshuǐ, 软 ruǎn, 睡衣 shuìyī
column18: 1) Nghe và chọn tranh (dạng YCT4 nghe – chọn tranh, 5 câu): 头疼 / 咳嗽 / 肚子疼 / 受伤 / 打针; nghe – chỉ tranh (không chấm, như bài 1 tiếng Anh): 感冒 / 吃药 / 洗发水 / 睡衣. 2) Ghép vấn đề với lời khuyên 应该 / 不应该 (4 cặp): 我头疼。– 你应该休息。/ 我咳嗽，还发烧。– 你应该去看医生。/ 我肚子疼。– 你不应该吃冰淇淋。/ 我流了很多汗。– 你应该洗澡。 3) Đóng vai bác sĩ – bệnh nhân: 你怎么了？——我头疼，还咳嗽。——你应该吃药，多休息。——谢谢医生！——不客气！ Phương án nhiễu: 围巾 / 牛仔裤 / 衬衫. 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh phòng khám: rối Leo nói I've got a headache. You should take some medicine., rối Xiaomei nói 我头疼。你应该吃药。(Wǒ tóuténg. Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào.); con tìm: should ↔ 应该 đứng trước động từ ở cả hai tiếng; take medicine ↔ 吃药 (dùng 吃); ice cream ↔ 冰淇淋 âm gần giống. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Rối Leo kể truyện tiếng Anh 'A Busy Day at the Doctor's'; con tóm tắt cho rối Xiaomei bằng 2 câu tiếng Trung: Leo感冒了，应该吃药，多休息。弟弟肚子疼，不应该吃那么多冰淇淋。(Leo gǎnmào le, yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi. Dìdi dùzi téng, bù yīnggāi chī nàme duō bīngqílín.)
column19: 医生很忙 — 今天医生很忙。Leo感冒了，医生说：“你应该吃药，多休息。”Xiaomei的弟弟肚子疼，医生说：“你不应该吃那么多冰淇淋！”Nhan的膝盖受伤了，流了一点儿血。护士用香皂和水帮他洗干净，说：“准备好了吗？不疼。”然后，她用软软的绷带包好。Nhan说：“谢谢！”护士说：“不客气！下次要小心！”(Jīntiān yīshēng hěn máng. Leo gǎnmào le, yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi.” Xiaomei de dìdi dùzi téng, yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī nàme duō bīngqílín!” Nhan de xīgài shòushāng le, liúle yìdiǎnr xiě. Hùshi yòng xiāngzào hé shuǐ bāng tā xǐ gānjìng, shuō: “Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Bù téng.” Ránhòu, tā yòng ruǎnruǎn de bēngdài bāo hǎo. Nhan shuō: “Xièxie!” Hùshi shuō: “Bú kèqi! Xià cì yào xiǎoxīn!”)
column20: 你怎么了 (giai điệu Two Tigers 两只老虎 – cùng giai điệu Frère Jacques của bài tiếng Anh) — 你怎么了？你怎么了？我感冒，我感冒。你应该去休息，你应该吃点药，早点好！早点好！(Nǐ zěnme le? Nǐ zěnme le? Wǒ gǎnmào, wǒ gǎnmào. Nǐ yīnggāi qù xiūxi, nǐ yīnggāi chī diǎn yào, zǎo diǎn hǎo! Zǎo diǎn hǎo!)

column1: Ngày 66. Unit 8 · Cẩn thận kẻo ngã!
column2: Mới: soap, shampoo, soft, lovely, ready | Ôn nhanh: pajamas (UK pyjamas), online | Ôn: wash, towel, ice cream
column3: Mới: wash your hands with soap / a bottle of shampoo / soft pyjamas / Are you ready? | Ôn: have a bath / be careful
column4: [Ngữ pháp: should / shouldn't] You should wash your hands with soap. / You shouldn't eat ice cream. / These pyjamas are soft and lovely. / Are you ready for bed? – Yes, I am. / [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Con nghe truyện tiếng Trung '小心！', nói lại ý chính cho Leo bằng 2 câu tiếng Anh (ghi âm): Xiaomei's brother plays football and has a bath. Then he eats lots of ice cream and has a stomach-ache.
column5: Be Careful! — Xiaomei's little brother is playing football in the garden. He is very hot. 'You should have a bath,' says Mum. 'Be careful! The floor is wet.' He washes with soap and shampoo. Then he puts on his soft, lovely pyjamas. After that, he eats lots of ice cream. At night, he has a stomach-ache and he runs to the toilet again and again. 'You shouldn't eat so much ice cream!' says Mum.

column7: Mới: 拉肚子 lā dùzi (= tranh: runs to the toilet again and again), 小心 xiǎoxīn (= be careful), 流汗 liú hàn (= tranh: very hot after football) | Nghe làm quen: 香皂 xiāngzào (= soap), 洗发水 xǐfàshuǐ (= shampoo), 软 ruǎn (= soft) | Ôn nhanh: 网上 wǎng shang | Ôn: 肚子疼 dùzi téng (stomach-ache), 洗 xǐ, 毛巾 máojīn, 冰淇淋 bīngqílín, 受伤 shòushāng, 睡衣 shuìyī
column8: Mới: 流了很多汗 liúle hěn duō hàn / 小心！xiǎoxīn! / 拉肚子了 lā dùzi le | Nghe làm quen: 用香皂洗手 yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu / 一瓶洗发水 yì píng xǐfàshuǐ / 软软的睡衣 ruǎnruǎn de shuìyī | Ôn: 别受伤 bié shòushāng / 肚子疼 dùzi téng
column9: [Cầu nối] You shouldn't eat ice cream. ↔ 你不应该吃冰淇淋。(Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī bīngqílín.) · giống: shouldn't ↔ 不应该; ice cream ↔ 冰淇淋 (âm gần giống) · khác: Be careful! ↔ 小心！(không cần be) / [Ngữ pháp: 应该 / 不应该] 你不应该吃冰淇淋。(Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī bīngqílín.) / 你应该用香皂洗手。(Nǐ yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu.) / 这件睡衣又软又漂亮。(Zhè jiàn shuìyī yòu ruǎn yòu piàoliang.) / 准备好睡觉了吗？——好了！(Zhǔnbèi hǎo shuìjiào le ma? — Hǎo le!) / 小心！地上有水。(Xiǎoxīn! Dì shang yǒu shuǐ.) / 我流了很多汗，应该洗澡。(Wǒ liúle hěn duō hàn, yīnggāi xǐzǎo.)
column10: 小心！ — 弟弟在花园里踢足球，流了很多汗。妈妈说：“你应该洗澡。小心！地上有水，别受伤！”他用香皂和洗发水洗澡，然后穿上又软又漂亮的睡衣。洗完澡，弟弟吃了很多冰淇淋。晚上，他肚子疼，还拉肚子了。妈妈说：“你不应该吃那么多冰淇淋！”(Dìdi zài huāyuán lǐ tī zúqiú, liúle hěn duō hàn. Māma shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi xǐzǎo. Xiǎoxīn! Dì shang yǒu shuǐ, bié shòushāng!” Tā yòng xiāngzào hé xǐfàshuǐ xǐzǎo, ránhòu chuān shang yòu ruǎn yòu piàoliang de shuìyī. Xǐ wán zǎo, dìdi chīle hěn duō bīngqílín. Wǎnshang, tā dùzi téng, hái lā dùzi le. Māma shuō: “Nǐ bù yīnggāi chī nàme duō bīngqílín!”)

column1: Ngày 67. Unit 8 · Nhan lười và bác sĩ tốt bụng
column2: Mới: kind, pleased, lazy, popular | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): interested, score, race, coach, gymnastics, x-ray, tent
column3: Mới: a kind doctor / be pleased with / a popular sport / Don't be lazy! | Ôn: be interested in / have an x-ray / do gymnastics
column4: [Ngữ pháp: should / shouldn't; quá khứ trong câu mẫu got hurt] He got hurt when he was playing football. / You should brush your teeth every morning. Don't be lazy! / I'm interested in gymnastics. / Football is a very popular sport. / The coach is pleased with our team. / It's easy to get hurt when you run too fast.
column5: Lazy Nhan — One morning, Nhan is lazy and not careful. He doesn't wash his face or brush his teeth. He goes to the sports hall for a football match. He runs too fast and gets hurt. A kind doctor gives him an x-ray. 'It's easy to get hurt when you run so fast. It isn't broken, but you shouldn't play football this week,' she says. Nhan is interested in the x-ray picture. 'I'm not lazy any more!' he says. His coach is pleased.
column6: Tìm YouTube: "good habits for kids brush your teeth don't be lazy"
column7: Mới: 脸 liǎn (= face), 刷牙 shuāyá (= brush your teeth), 容易 róngyì (= easy), 马虎 mǎhu (= not careful) | Nghe làm quen: 懒 lǎn (= lazy) | Ôn (từ nối Unit 7): 感兴趣 gǎn xìngqù, 比赛 bǐsài, 体育馆 tǐyùguǎn, X光片 X guāngpiàn, 教练 jiàoliàn, 体操 tǐcāo
column8: Mới: 洗脸 xǐ liǎn / 刷牙 shuāyá / 很容易受伤 hěn róngyì shòushāng / 别马虎 bié mǎhu | Nghe làm quen: 别懒 bié lǎn | Ôn: 对X光片感兴趣 duì X guāngpiàn gǎn xìngqù
column9: [Cầu nối] You should brush your teeth every morning. ↔ 你应该每天早上刷牙。(Nǐ yīnggāi měi tiān zǎoshang shuāyá.) · giống: should ↔ 应该 · khác: every morning cuối câu ↔ 每天早上 trước 刷牙; brush your teeth ↔ 刷牙 (không cần your) / [Ngữ pháp: 应该 / 不应该] 你应该每天早上刷牙、洗脸。(Nǐ yīnggāi měi tiān zǎoshang shuāyá, xǐ liǎn.) / 早上不应该懒，也不应该马虎。(Zǎoshang bù yīnggāi lǎn, yě bù yīnggāi mǎhu.) / 跑得太快很容易受伤。(Pǎo de tài kuài hěn róngyì shòushāng.) / 我对体操很感兴趣。(Wǒ duì tǐcāo hěn gǎn xìngqù.) / 很多人喜欢踢足球。(Hěn duō rén xǐhuan tī zúqiú.) / 他比赛的时候受伤了。(Tā bǐsài de shíhou shòushāng le.)
column10: 马虎的Nhan — 一天早上，Nhan很懒，也很马虎。他不洗脸，也不刷牙，就去体育馆比赛。比赛的时候，他跑得太快，受伤了。一个很和蔼的医生给他拍了X光片，说：“跑得太快很容易受伤。没有断，可是你这个星期不应该踢足球。”Nhan对X光片很感兴趣。他说：“我以后不懒了！”教练很高兴。(Yì tiān zǎoshang, Nhan hěn lǎn, yě hěn mǎhu. Tā bù xǐ liǎn, yě bù shuāyá, jiù qù tǐyùguǎn bǐsài. Bǐsài de shíhou, tā pǎo de tài kuài, shòushāng le. Yí gè hěn hé'ǎi de yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn, shuō: “Pǎo de tài kuài hěn róngyì shòushāng. Méiyǒu duàn, kěshì nǐ zhège xīngqī bù yīnggāi tī zúqiú.” Nhan duì X guāngpiàn hěn gǎn xìngqù. Tā shuō: “Wǒ yǐhòu bù lǎn le!” Jiàoliàn hěn gāoxìng.)

(low / large) / Don't tell anyone. It's a ___! (secret / same) Phương án nhiễu: spotted / striped / pocket. 2) Chọn should hoặc shouldn't (4 câu): You ___ brush your teeth every day. / You ___ be lazy in the morning. / You ___ play football with a broken foot. / You ___ speak in a low voice in hospital. 3) Kể lại truyện 'Lazy Nhan' theo 4 tranh, mỗi tranh 1 câu có should / shouldn't. 4) [Chuyển ngữ] (NL5) Rối Xiaomei kể truyện tiếng Trung '马虎的Nhan'; con tóm tắt cho rối Leo bằng 2–3 câu tiếng Anh: Nhan doesn't brush his teeth and he gets hurt at the football match. In the hospital, Grandma's glasses are missing and Nhan finds them.
column15: Lazy Nhan and Grandma's Secret — One morning, Nhan is lazy and not careful. He doesn't wash his face or brush his teeth. He goes to the sports hall for a football match. He runs too fast and gets hurt. A kind doctor gives him an x-ray. 'It's easy to get hurt when you run so fast. It isn't broken, but you shouldn't play football this week.' Nhan is interested in the x-ray picture. In the same hospital, Grandma is in bed. 'You should speak in a low voice here,' says the nurse. Grandma's glasses are missing! Nhan finds them under her bed. 'I've got a secret,' says Grandma. 'I'm going home tomorrow!' Nhan is very pleased.
column16: Should and Shouldn't (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb) — You should brush your teeth each day, teeth each day, teeth each day. / You should brush your teeth each day, don't be lazy, no! / You shouldn't shout in hospital, hospital, hospital. / Speak in a low voice in hospital, shh, shh, shh!

column18: 1) Đọc và chọn từ (dạng YCT4 đọc – chọn từ, 5 câu): 早上要刷牙、洗___。(脸) / 做作业不应该___。(马虎) / 跑得太快很___受伤。(容易) / 真___，我的眼镜在哪儿？(奇怪) / 这个声音很___，是爷爷！(熟悉) Phương án nhiễu: 旗袍 / 售货员 / 夹克衫. 2) Chọn 应该 hoặc 不应该 (4 câu, như bài 2 tiếng Anh): 你___每天刷牙。(应该) / 早上你___懒。(不应该) / 脚受伤了，你___踢足球。(不应该) / 在医院里你___小声说话。(应该) 3) Kể lại truyện '马虎的Nhan' theo 4 tranh (như bài 3 tiếng Anh), mỗi tranh 1 câu có 应该 / 不应该: 早上应该刷牙、洗脸。/ 跑得太快很容易受伤。/ 你这个星期不应该踢足球。/ 在医院里应该小声说话。 4) YCT口试（中级）第三部分 回答问题 (mẫu; cô là giám khảo, từng em; 2 câu hỏi in kèm pinyin, mỗi câu trả lời 3–4 câu): 问题1：生病的时候，你应该做什么？(Shēngbìng de shíhou, nǐ yīnggāi zuò shénme?) — câu mẫu: 生病的时候，我应该去看医生，好好吃药。我应该多喝水，多休息。我不应该吃冰淇淋。(Shēngbìng de shíhou, wǒ yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng, hǎohāo chī yào. Wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi. Wǒ bù yīnggāi chī bīngqílín.) / 问题2：你每天早上做什么？(Nǐ měi tiān zǎoshang zuò shénme?) — câu mẫu: 我每天早上六点起床，刷牙、洗脸，然后吃早饭。七点我和妈妈一起去学校。(Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang liù diǎn qǐchuáng, shuāyá, xǐ liǎn, ránhòu chī zǎofàn. Qī diǎn wǒ hé māma yìqǐ qù xuéxiào.) 5) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng tranh 'Lazy Nhan': He doesn't wash his face or brush his teeth. ↔ 他不刷牙，也不洗脸。(Tā bù shuāyá, yě bù xǐ liǎn.); con tìm: doesn't ↔ 不, or ↔ 也不, brush his teeth ↔ 刷牙 (không cần his); How strange! ↔ 真奇怪！
column19: 马虎的Nhan — 一天早上，Nhan很懒，也很马虎。他不洗脸，也不刷牙，就去体育馆比赛。他跑得太快，受伤了。一个很和蔼的医生给他拍了X光片，说：“跑得太快很容易受伤。没有断，可是你这个星期不应该踢足球。”Nhan对X光片很感兴趣。在同一个医院里，奶奶在床上休息。护士说：“在这里应该小声说话。”奶奶的眼镜不见了！Nhan在床下面找到了。奶奶说：“我有一个秘密：我明天回家！”Nhan很高兴。(Yì tiān zǎoshang, Nhan hěn lǎn, yě hěn mǎhu. Tā bù xǐ liǎn, yě bù shuāyá, jiù qù tǐyùguǎn bǐsài. Tā pǎo de tài kuài, shòushāng le. Yí gè hěn hé'ǎi de yīshēng gěi tā pāile X guāngpiàn, shuō: “Pǎo de tài kuài hěn róngyì shòushāng. Méiyǒu duàn, kěshì nǐ zhège xīngqī bù yīnggāi tī zúqiú.” Nhan duì X guāngpiàn hěn gǎn xìngqù. Zài tóng yí gè yīyuàn lǐ, nǎinai zài chuáng shang xiūxi. Hùshi shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ yīnggāi xiǎoshēng shuōhuà.” Nǎinai de yǎnjìng bú jiàn le! Nhan zài chuáng xiàmiàn zhǎodào le. Nǎinai shuō: “Wǒ yǒu yí gè mìmì: wǒ míngtiān huí jiā!” Nhan hěn gāoxìng.)
column20: 应该和不应该 (giai điệu Mary Had a Little Lamb, như bài tiếng Anh) — 每天应该刷刷牙，刷刷牙，刷刷牙。每天应该刷刷牙，不要懒哦！医院里面别大声，别大声，别大声。医院里面小声说，嘘，嘘，嘘！(Měi tiān yīnggāi shuā shua yá, shuā shua yá, shuā shua yá. column10: 奶奶的秘密 — 奶奶在医院里。Anna和Leo去看她。护士说：“在这里应该小声说话。”奶奶说：“真奇怪，我的眼镜不见了！”Leo在床下面找到了眼镜，和昨天在一样的地方！这时候，他们听到一个很熟悉的声音，是爷爷！爷爷提着一个大包，说：“我有一个秘密：医生说奶奶的高血压好多了，明天可以回家了！”(Nǎinai zài yīyuàn lǐ. Anna hé Leo qù kàn tā. Hùshi shuō: “Zài zhèlǐ yīnggāi xiǎoshēng shuōhuà.” Nǎinai shuō: “Zhēn qíguài, wǒ de yǎnjìng bú jiàn le!” Leo zài chuáng xiàmiàn zhǎodàole yǎnjìng, hé zuótiān zài yíyàng de dìfang! column18: 1) Ôn không tranh – cô đọc câu, con nói từ (6 câu, như bài 1 tiếng Anh): 生病的时候要吃它。(药) / 头很疼。(头疼) / 吃了很多冰淇淋，肚子不舒服。(肚子疼) / 早上起床以后要___。(刷牙) / 一家人在一起，很高兴。(幸福) / 不要告诉别人！(秘密 – con chỉ tranh) · nghe – chỉ tranh (không chấm): 洗发水 / 香皂 / 流血. 2) Đọc bản tin và phán đoán đúng/sai (dạng YCT4 đọc – phán đoán, 4 câu): 最近很多孩子感冒了。(✓) / 大家应该少洗手。(✗) / Leo头疼。(✓) / 爸爸让Leo一直看电视。(✗) 3) Làm việc nhóm – thực đơn '特别的一天' cho bà: 奶奶应该吃___。/ 奶奶不应该吃___。 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng bản tin 'Flu on the News' (bảng tiếng Anh và bảng tiếng Trung đặt cạnh nhau): Lots of children have got flu. ↔ 很多孩子感冒了。/ You should wash your hands with soap. ↔ 你们应该用香皂洗手。(Hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le. / Nǐmen yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu.); con nối từng dòng hai bảng, nhận xét: have got ↔ 了 (đã xảy ra), children (số nhiều) ↔ 孩子 không đổi; you (cả lớp) ↔ 你们; wash … with soap ↔ 用香皂洗 (用 + đồ vật đứng trước động từ). 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Con đọc bảng tin sức khỏe tiếng Anh (Lots of children have got flu. / Wash your hands with soap. / Get lots of rest. / Don't watch TV all day.), nói lại 2–3 ý chính cho bạn chỉ hiểu tiếng Trung: 最近很多孩子感冒了。大家应该多洗手，多休息，不应该一直看电视。(Zuìjìn hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le. Dàjiā yīnggāi duō xǐ shǒu, duō xiūxi, bù yīnggāi yìzhí kàn diànshì.)
column19: 特别的一天 — 今天是特别的一天，奶奶从医院回家了！妈妈做了一顿特别的晚饭，可是菜不油。妈妈说：“奶奶应该吃健康的菜。”Leo又咳嗽了，奶奶说：“可怜的Leo！你应该多喝热水，多休息。”吃完饭，爸爸打开电视看新闻。新闻说：“这个月很多孩子感冒了，大家应该用香皂洗手。”奶奶说：“Leo，你听到了吗？”大家都笑了。一家人在一起，大家都觉得很幸福。(Jīntiān shì tèbié de yì tiān, nǎinai cóng yīyuàn huí jiā le! Māma zuòle yí dùn tèbié de wǎnfàn, kěshì cài bù yóu. Māma shuō: “Nǎinai yīnggāi chī jiànkāng de cài.” Leo yòu késou le, nǎinai shuō: “Kělián de Leo! Nǐ yīnggāi duō hē rè shuǐ, duō xiūxi.” Chī wán fàn, bàba dǎkāi diànshì kàn xīnwén. Xīnwén shuō: “Zhège yuè hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le, dàjiā yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu.” Nǎinai shuō: “Leo, nǐ tīngdào le ma?” Dàjiā dōu xiào le. Yì jiā rén zài yìqǐ, dàjiā dōu juéde hěn xìngfú.)
column20: 洗洗手 (giai điệu Row Row Row Your Boat, như bài tiếng Anh) — 洗，洗，洗洗手，用香皂洗手！多睡多休息吃好饭，不要感冒哦！洗，洗，洗头发，头发软软的！健康快乐每一天，特别的一天！(Xǐ, xǐ, xǐ xi shǒu, yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu! Duō shuì duō xiūxi chī hǎo fàn, bú yào gǎnmào o! Xǐ, xǐ, xǐ tóufa, tóufa ruǎnruǎn de! Jiànkāng kuàilè měi yì tiān, tèbié de yì tiān!)

column9: [Cầu nối] What's the matter? – I've got a headache. ↔ 你怎么了？——我头疼。(Nǐ zěnme le? — Wǒ tóuténg.) · giống: hỏi thăm – trả lời ngắn · khác: I've got a headache ↔ 我头疼 (không có got / a); The news says … ↔ 新闻说…… / [Ngữ pháp: 你怎么了？và 应该 / 不应该 – ôn] 你怎么了？——我头疼。(Nǐ zěnme le? — Wǒ tóuténg.) / 你应该关掉电视，去睡觉。(Nǐ yīnggāi guāndiào diànshì, qù shuìjiào.) / 生病的时候不应该一直看电视。(Shēngbìng de shíhou bù yīnggāi yìzhí kàn diànshì.) / 新闻说最近很多孩子感冒了。(Xīnwén shuō zuìjìn hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le.) / 踢完足球，我流了很多汗。——你应该洗澡。(Tī wán zúqiú, wǒ liúle hěn duō hàn. — Nǐ yīnggāi xǐzǎo.)
column10: 新闻里的感冒 — 爸爸正在看一频道的新闻。新闻说：“这个月很多孩子感冒了，大家应该用香皂洗手，多休息。”Leo也在看。爸爸问：“Leo，你怎么了？”Leo说：“我头疼。”爸爸说：“那你应该关掉电视，去睡觉！”(Bàba zhèngzài kàn yī píndào de xīnwén. Xīnwén shuō: “Zhège yuè hěn duō háizi gǎnmào le, dàjiā yīnggāi yòng xiāngzào xǐ shǒu, duō xiūxi.” Leo yě zài kàn. Bàba wèn: “Leo, nǐ zěnme le?” Leo shuō: “Wǒ tóuténg.” Bàba shuō: “Nà nǐ yīnggāi guāndiào diànshì, qù shuìjiào!”)

column4: [Ngữ pháp: should / shouldn't – chuyển ngữ Trung → Anh] [Chuyển ngữ] 你怎么了？→ What's the matter with you? / 我咳嗽，还发烧。→ I've got a cough and a fever. / 你应该去看医生。→ You should see a doctor. / 他踢足球的时候受伤了。→ He got hurt when he was playing football.
column5: Nhan at the Hospital — Nhan injured his arm when he was playing football. There is a little blood. At the hospital, a kind nurse looks at it with a torch. 'Are you ready? You need an injection,' she says. Nhan is worried, but he is brave. He reads a magazine about doctors. 'What a surprise! It doesn't hurt!' The doctor is pleased. 'You should rest your arm for a week.'

column9: [Cầu nối] He got hurt when he was playing football. ↔ 他踢足球的时候受伤了。(Tā tī zúqiú de shíhou shòushāng le.) · giống: chuyện đã xảy ra: got (quá khứ) ↔ 了 · khác: when … đứng sau ↔ ……的时候 đứng trước / [Ngữ pháp: 应该 / 不应该 – chuyển ngữ Anh → Trung] [Chuyển ngữ] What's the matter with you? → 你怎么了？(Nǐ zěnme le?) / Are you ready? You need an injection. → 准备好了吗？你要打针。(Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Nǐ yào dǎzhēn.) / It doesn't hurt! → 不疼！(Bù téng!) / You should rest your arm for a week. → 你的胳膊应该休息一个星期。(Nǐ de gēbo yīnggāi xiūxi yí gè xīngqī.)
column10: 勇敢的Nhan — Nhan踢足球的时候，胳膊受伤了，流了一点儿血。在医院里，一个很好心的护士用手电筒看了看。她说：“准备好了吗？你要打针。”Nhan有一点儿担心，可是他很勇敢。他一边看一本关于医生的杂志，一边打针。Nhan很惊奇：“不疼！”医生很高兴，说：“你的胳膊应该休息一个星期。”(Nhan tī zúqiú de shíhou, gēbo shòushāng le, liúle yìdiǎnr xiě. Zài yīyuàn lǐ, yí gè hěn hǎoxīn de hùshi yòng shǒudiàntǒng kànle kàn. Tā shuō: “Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Nǐ yào dǎzhēn.” Nhan yǒu yìdiǎnr dānxīn, kěshì tā hěn yǒnggǎn. Tā yìbiān kàn yì běn guānyú yīshēng de zázhì, yìbiān dǎzhēn. Nhan hěn jīngqí: “Bù téng!” Yīshēng hěn gāoxìng, shuō: “Nǐ de gēbo yīnggāi xiūxi yí gè xīngqī.”)

column16: Get Well Soon (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star) — Get well, get well, get well soon, / Take your medicine, rest in your room. / Wash with soap and drink some tea, / Soon you'll play outside with me! / Get well, get well, get well soon, / We all miss you, get well soon!

column19: 勇敢的Nhan — Nhan踢足球的时候，胳膊受伤了，流了一点儿血。在医院里，一个很好心的护士用手电筒看了看。她说：“准备好了吗？你要打针。”Nhan有一点儿担心，可是他很勇敢。他一边看一本关于医生的杂志，一边打针。Nhan很惊奇：“不疼！”医生很高兴，说：“你的胳膊应该休息一个星期。”回到家，朋友们给他寄来一张特别的明信片，还在网上发来一个好笑的卡通片：“Nhan，早点好！这个星期你不应该踢足球！”(Nhan tī zúqiú de shíhou, gēbo shòushāng le, liúle yìdiǎnr xiě. Zài yīyuàn lǐ, yí gè hěn hǎoxīn de hùshi yòng shǒudiàntǒng kànle kàn. Tā shuō: “Zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Nǐ yào dǎzhēn.” Nhan yǒu yìdiǎnr dānxīn, kěshì tā hěn yǒnggǎn. Tā yìbiān kàn yì běn guānyú yīshēng de zázhì, yìbiān dǎzhēn. Nhan hěn jīngqí: “Bù téng!” Yīshēng hěn gāoxìng, shuō: “Nǐ de gēbo yīnggāi xiūxi yí gè xīngqī.” Huí dào jiā, péngyoumen gěi tā jì lái yì zhāng tèbié de míngxìnpiàn, hái zài wǎng shang fā lái yí gè hǎoxiào de kǎtōngpiàn: “Nhan, zǎo diǎn hǎo! Zhège xīngqī nǐ bù yīnggāi tī zúqiú!”)
column20: 早点好 (giai điệu Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, như bài tiếng Anh) — 早点好呀早点好！好好吃药多睡觉。香皂洗手喝杯茶，很快一起出去玩！早点好呀早点好！我们想你，早点好！(Zǎo diǎn hǎo ya zǎo diǎn hǎo! Hǎohāo chī yào duō shuìjiào. Xiāngzào xǐ shǒu hē bēi chá, hěn kuài yìqǐ chūqù wán! Zǎo diǎn hǎo ya zǎo diǎn hǎo! Wǒmen xiǎng nǐ, zǎo diǎn hǎo!)

Dad (is watching / watches) the news now. / She plays the violin (beautiful / beautifully). / (Why / What) do you like golf? – Because it's quiet. / I can ski, but I (can't / don't) snowboard. / You (should / shouldn't) eat ice cream when you've got a cough. / What's the (matter / wrong) with you? 3) Nói 1 phút theo thẻ chủ đề (TV / music / sport / illness): mỗi con rút 1 thẻ, nói 3 câu. 4) Thi thử Nói Flyers trọn đề (7–9 phút mỗi em; cô là giám khảo, gọi từng em ra góc thi trong lúc các bạn làm bài 1–3 với trợ giảng; ghi âm toàn bộ bài thi để chấm và lưu hồ sơ BRIDGE): Phần 1 – tìm 5 điểm khác giữa 2 tranh phòng khách: In my picture, the TV is on. – In my picture, it's off. / In my picture, the girl is playing the violin. – In my picture, she's playing the drum. / In my picture, the boy has got a football. – In my picture, he's got a tennis racket. / In my picture, there's some medicine on the shelf. – In my picture, there's some soap. / In my picture, the bike has got a flat tyre. – In my picture, the tyres are fine. Phần 2 – trao đổi thông tin, thẻ 'Sports Day' (cô) và 'TV Quiz Day' (con): con hỏi: Where is Sports Day? – At the stadium. / When is it? – On Friday. / What can you do there? – Bike racing and gymnastics. / Who is the coach? – Anna's dad. / Is it exciting? – Yes, very! Cô hỏi về thẻ của con: What's the quiz about? – Music. / What time is it? – At 6 p.m. / Which channel is it on? – Channel 7. / Who is going? – Leo and Nhan. / What can you win? – A big puzzle. Phần 3 – kể truyện 5 tranh 'The Camping Trip' (cô kể tranh 1: Leo's family goes camping near a river.; con kể tranh 2–5): They sleep in a tent. / It's dark, but they haven't got a torch. / Leo falls over and hurts his leg. / They go to hospital for an x-ray. Now Leo never goes camping without a torch! Phần 4 – câu hỏi về bản thân: What TV programmes do you like? / What instrument can you play? / Why do you like your favourite sport? / What should you do when you've got flu? / Tell me about your best friend.
column15: Leo's Big Month — This month, Leo watched lots of TV programmes: cartoons, the news and an interesting quiz. Then he got an invitation to a concert. He played a drum solo very well. Next, he joined a bike race. 'Why do you like racing?' asked Anna. 'Because it's exciting!' But on the day of the race, Leo had flu. 'You should take some medicine and rest,' said the doctor. Leo was unhappy, but his coach was kind. 'Don't worry. There's a special race next month!'

column18: 1) Trò chơi 'Kéo co từ vựng' theo 4 đội Unit 5 / 6 / 7 / 8 (16 tranh, cùng tranh với phần tiếng Anh): 卡通片 / 新闻 / 竞猜 / 手电筒 / 小提琴 / 鼓 / 演员 / 演出 / 高尔夫球 / 下棋 / 滑雪 / 帐篷 / 药 / 香皂 / 洗发水 / X光片. 2) Chọn từ đúng (dạng YCT4 đọc – chọn từ, 6 câu): 我___看电视。(正在) / 她唱___很好听。(得) / 大家高兴___唱歌。(地) / ___你喜欢游泳？(为什么) / 你___功夫吗？(会) / 你___去看医生。(应该) 3) Nói 1 phút theo thẻ chủ đề (电视 / 音乐 / 运动 / 生病): mỗi con rút 1 thẻ, nói 3 câu. 4) [Cầu nối Anh – Trung] Cùng 16 tranh trò 'Kéo co từ vựng': với mỗi tranh, một bạn nói từ tiếng Anh, bạn kia nói từ tiếng Trung (cartoon ↔ 卡通片, news ↔ 新闻, drum ↔ 鼓, actor ↔ 演员, medicine ↔ 药); cả lớp tìm điểm giống: 卡通片 (kǎtōng) đọc gần giống cartoon, 高尔夫球 (gāo'ěrfū) đọc gần giống golf; và nhóm từ có chung một chữ: 卡通片 / X光片 đều có 片 (piàn: tấm, phim), giống cartoon là phim, x-ray là tấm phim chụp. 5) [Chuyển ngữ] Rối Leo kể truyện tiếng Anh 'Leo's Big Month'; con tóm tắt cho rối Xiaomei bằng 3 câu tiếng Trung: Leo看了很多电视节目，还在演出上打鼓。比赛那天他感冒了，不能比赛。下个月还有一个特别的比赛。(Leo kànle hěn duō diànshì jiémù, hái zài yǎnchū shang dǎ gǔ. column19: Leo的一个月 — 这个月，Leo看了很多电视节目：卡通片、新闻，还有很有趣的竞猜。然后，他收到一张演出的邀请卡。演出的时候，他一个人打鼓，打得很好。后来，他参加自行车比赛。Anna问：“你为什么喜欢比赛？”Leo说：“因为很有意思！”可是比赛那天，Leo感冒了。医生说：“你应该吃药，多休息。”Leo有点儿不高兴，可是教练很和蔼，说：“别担心，下个月还有一个特别的比赛！”(Zhège yuè, Leo kànle hěn duō diànshì jiémù: kǎtōngpiàn, xīnwén, hái yǒu hěn yǒuqù de jìngcāi. Ránhòu, tā shōudào yì zhāng yǎnchū de yāoqǐngkǎ. Yǎnchū de shíhou, tā yí gè rén dǎ gǔ, dǎ de hěn hǎo. Hòulái, tā cānjiā zìxíngchē bǐsài. Anna wèn: “Nǐ wèi shénme xǐhuan bǐsài?” Leo shuō: “Yīnwèi hěn yǒu yìsi!” Kěshì bǐsài nà tiān, Leo gǎnmào le. Yīshēng shuō: “Nǐ yīnggāi chī yào, duō xiūxi.” Leo yǒudiǎnr bù gāoxìng, kěshì jiàoliàn hěn hé'ǎi, shuō: “Bié dānxīn, xià gè yuè hái yǒu yí gè tèbié de bǐsài!”)
column20: 第二阶段之歌 (giai điệu The Wheels on the Bus, như bài tiếng Anh) — 我家的电视开了又关，开了又关，开了又关。我家的电视开了又关，每一天！演出的鼓咚咚咚……每一天！比赛的自行车转啊转……每一天！医生说“你应该多休息”……每一天！(Wǒ jiā de diànshì kāile yòu guān, kāile yòu guān, kāile yòu guān. Wǒ jiā de diànshì kāile yòu guān, měi yì tiān! Yǎnchū de gǔ dōng dōng dōng… měi yì tiān! Bǐsài de zìxíngchē zhuàn a zhuàn… měi yì tiān! Yīshēng shuō “nǐ yīnggāi duō xiūxi”… měi yì tiān!)

In the evening, she cleans her room. Mum bought her new gloves online.
column5: Xiaomei's September — In September, it's still warm. Xiaomei lives on the tenth floor and she takes the lift to school every day. She is never late and she listens carefully in History and Science. At break time, she talks about homework with her friends. At nine p.m., she cleans her room and puts on her pyjamas. Mum gives her some new gloves. 'I bought them online for the winter.' 'Thank you, Mum!' 'You're welcome!'

column10: Xiaomei的九月 — 九月还很暖和。Xiaomei住在十楼，每天坐电梯去上学。她每天准时到学校，上历史课和科学课的时候认真听。课间休息的时候，她和同学们在校园里讨论作业。晚上九点，她打扫房间，换上睡衣。妈妈在网上给她买了一双新手套。Xiaomei说：“谢谢妈妈！”妈妈说：“不客气！”(Jiǔyuè hái hěn nuǎnhuo. Xiaomei zhù zài shí lóu, měi tiān zuò diàntī qù shàngxué. Tā měi tiān zhǔnshí dào xuéxiào, shàng lìshǐ kè hé kēxué kè de shíhou rènzhēn tīng. Kèjiān xiūxi de shíhou, tā hé tóngxuémen zài xiàoyuán lǐ tǎolùn zuòyè. Wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn, tā dǎsǎo fángjiān, huàn shang shuìyī. Māma zài wǎng shang gěi tā mǎile yì shuāng xīn shǒutào. Xiaomei shuō: “Xièxie māma!” Māma shuō: “Bú kèqi!”)
